verses.1:1: Blessed is the man who has not gone in the counsel of the ungodly, and has not stood in the way of sinners, and has not sat in the seat of pestilence.
verses.1:2: But in the law of the Lord is his will, and on His law he will meditate day and night.
verses.1:3: And he will be like a tree that has been planted beside channels of water, which will give its fruit in its season; and its leaf will not fall away, and everything that he will do will prosper.
verses.1:4: Not so the ungodly, not so, but like dust that the wind drives away from the face of the earth.
verses.1:5: Therefore the ungodly will not rise again in judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
verses.1:6: For the Lord knows the way of the righteous, and the path of the ungodly will perish.
verses.2:1: Why have the nations raged, and the peoples meditated on empty things?
verses.2:2: The kings of the earth have taken their stand, and the rulers have come together as one against the Lord and against His Anointed.
verses.2:3: "Let us burst Their bonds apart and cast off Their yoke from us."
verses.2:4: He who dwells in the heavens will laugh at them, and the Lord will scoff at them.
verses.2:5: Then He will speak to them in His wrath, and in His fury He will throw them into turmoil.
verses.2:6: Yet I have been established as king by Him over Zion, His holy mountain, proclaiming His decree.
verses.2:7: The Lord said to Me, "You are My Son; today I have fathered You.
verses.2:8: Ask of Me, and I will give You the nations as Your inheritance, and as Your possession the ends of the earth.
verses.2:9: You will rule them with an iron rod, and like a potter's vessel You will shatter them."
verses.2:10: And now, kings, understand; be instructed, you who judge the earth.
verses.2:11: Serve the Lord in fear, and exult to Him with trembling.
verses.2:12: Take hold of discipline, so that the Lord may not at any time become angry, and you may not perish from the righteous way. When His wrath flares up in a short time, blessed are all who trust in Him.
verses.3:1: A psalm of David, when he was fleeing from the face of Absalom his son.
verses.3:2: Lord, why have those who afflict me multiplied? Many rise up against me.
verses.3:3: Many are saying to my soul, "He has no salvation in his God."
verses.3:4: Yet You, Lord, are my upholder, my glory, and the One who raises up my head.
verses.3:5: With my voice I cried out to the Lord, and He heard me from His holy mountain.
verses.3:6: I slept and fell into deep slumber; and I rose up, because the Lord upheld me.
verses.3:7: I will not be afraid of thousands of people surrounding me. Rise up, Lord; save me, my God.
verses.3:8: For You have struck all who oppose me without cause; You have crushed the teeth of sinners.
verses.3:9: Salvation is the Lord's, and upon Your people is Your blessing.
verses.4:1: To the end, in songs. A psalm of David.
verses.4:2: When I called out, the God of my righteousness heard me; in distress You made room for me. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
verses.4:3: Sons of men, how long will you be heavy of heart? Why do you love emptiness and seek falsehood?
verses.4:4: And know that the Lord has wonderfully honored His holy one; the Lord will hear me when I cry out to Him.
verses.4:5: Be angry, and do not sin; over what you say in your hearts, feel remorse on your beds.
verses.4:6: Offer a sacrifice of righteousness, and hope in the Lord. Many say, "Who shows us good things?"
verses.4:7: The light of Your face has been sealed upon us, Lord; You have given gladness in my heart.
verses.4:8: From the fruit of their grain, wine, and oil, they have been multiplied.
verses.4:9: In peace, at once, I will sleep and rest; for You, Lord, have uniquely established me in hope.
verses.5:1: To the end, for her who attains the inheritance. A psalm of David.
verses.5:2: Receive my words with Your ears, Lord; understand my cry.
verses.5:3: Attend to the voice of my prayer, my King and my God.
verses.5:4: For I will pray to You, Lord; in the morning You will hear my voice.
verses.5:5: In the morning I will stand before You, and I will see that You are not a God who wills iniquity.
verses.5:6: Neither will a wicked person dwell beside You, nor will the unrighteous remain before Your eyes.
verses.5:7: You hate all who practice iniquity; You will destroy all who speak falsehood. The Lord will abhor a deceitful man of bloodshed.
verses.5:8: But I, in the multitude of Your mercy, will enter Your house; I will worship toward Your holy temple in fear of You.
verses.5:9: Lord, lead me in Your righteousness; because of my enemies, make my way straight in Your sight.
verses.5:10: For there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is empty.
verses.5:11: Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they acted deceitfully; judge them, God. Let them fall from their designs; according to the multitude of their impieties drive them out, for they have provoked You, Lord.
verses.5:12: And let all who hope in You be glad; they will exult forever, and You will dwell in them. And all who love Your name will glory in You,
verses.5:13: for You will bless the righteous one. Lord, as with a shield of Your good will, You have crowned us.
verses.6:1: To the end, in songs. A psalm of David. For the eighth.
verses.6:2: Lord, do not reprove me in Your fury, nor discipline me in Your anger.
verses.6:3: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak; heal me, Lord, for my bones are deeply troubled.
verses.6:4: And my soul is greatly troubled; but You, Lord, how long?
verses.6:5: Turn back, Lord, and rescue my soul; save me because of Your mercy.
verses.6:6: For in death there is no one who remembers You; and in the underworld, who will give praise to You?
verses.6:7: I have grown weary in my groaning; every single night I will wash my bed; with my tears I will soak my bedding.
verses.6:8: My eye is troubled from fury; I have grown old among all my enemies.
verses.6:9: Depart from me, all you who practice iniquity, for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.6:10: The Lord has heard my plea; the Lord has accepted my prayer.
verses.6:11: Let all my enemies be put to shame and severely troubled; let them turn back and be put to shame very swiftly.
verses.7:1: A psalm of David, which he sang to the Lord concerning the words of Cushi, son of Jemini.
verses.7:2: Lord, my God, in You I have hoped; save me from all who pursue me, and deliver me,
verses.7:3: so that he may never seize my soul like a lion, while there is no one to redeem, nor anyone to save.
verses.7:4: Lord, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
verses.7:5: if I have paid back those who return evil to me, may I deservedly fall away empty from my enemies.
verses.7:6: Let the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it; and let him trample my life on the ground, and bring my glory down into the dust.
verses.7:7: Rise up, Lord, in Your anger, and be exalted in the borders of my enemies; and rise up, Lord, my God, in the decree that You have commanded,
verses.7:8: and an assembly of peoples will surround You; and on account of it, return on high.
verses.7:9: The Lord judges the peoples. Judge me, Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to my innocence upon me.
verses.7:10: The wickedness of sinners will be consumed, and You will direct the righteous, searching hearts and kidneys, God.
verses.7:11: My just help is from the Lord, who saves those upright in heart.
verses.7:12: God is a righteous judge, strong and patient; does He grow angry every single day?
verses.7:13: Unless you turn back, He will brandish His sword; He has bent His bow and prepared it.
verses.7:14: And in it He has prepared implements of death; He has fashioned His arrows for those who burn.
verses.7:15: Look, he has been in labor with injustice; he has conceived pain and given birth to iniquity.
verses.7:16: He opened a pit and dug it out, and he fell into the pitfall that he made.
verses.7:17: His pain will turn back upon his own head, and upon the crown of his own head his iniquity will descend.
verses.7:18: I will give thanks to the Lord according to His righteousness, and I will sing psalms to the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.8:1: To the end, for the winepresses. A psalm of David.
verses.8:2: Lord, our Lord, how wondrous is Your name throughout the whole earth! For Your splendor has been lifted above the heavens.
verses.8:3: From the mouth of infants and nursing babies You have perfected praise on account of Your enemies, so that You may destroy the enemy and the avenger.
verses.8:4: For I will see Your heavens, the works of Your fingers, the moon and the stars that You have founded.
verses.8:5: What is man, that You remember him? Or the son of man, that You visit him?
verses.8:6: You have made him a little less than the angels; with glory and honor You have crowned him,
verses.8:7: and You have appointed him over the works of Your hands.
verses.8:8: You have subjected all things beneath his feet, sheep and oxen, all of them, and in addition the beasts of the field,
verses.8:9: the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea that traverse the paths of the sea.
verses.8:10: Lord, our Lord, how wondrous is Your name throughout the whole earth!
verses.9:1: To the end, for the hidden things of the son. A psalm of David.
verses.9:2: I will give thanks to You, Lord, with my whole heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
verses.9:3: I will be glad and exult in You; I will sing psalms to Your name, Most High.
verses.9:4: When my enemy is turned backward, they will grow weak and perish from before Your face.
verses.9:5: For You have carried out my judgment and my cause; You have sat upon the throne, You who judge righteousness.
verses.9:6: You have rebuked the nations, and the ungodly one has perished; You have blotted out their name forever, and for age upon age.
verses.9:7: The swords of the enemy have failed to the end, and You have destroyed their cities. Their memory has perished with a sound,
verses.9:8: and the Lord remains forever. He has prepared His throne in judgment,
verses.9:9: and He Himself will judge the world in equity; He will judge the peoples in righteousness.
verses.9:10: And the Lord has become a refuge for the poor man, a helper in times of need, in tribulation.
verses.9:11: And let those who know Your name hope in You, for You have not abandoned those who seek You, Lord.
verses.9:12: Sing psalms to the Lord, who dwells in Zion; proclaim among the nations His endeavors,
verses.9:13: for He who requires their blood has remembered; He has not forgotten the cry of the poor.
verses.9:14: Have mercy on me, Lord; see my humiliation from my enemies,
verses.9:15: You who lift me up from the gates of death, so that I may proclaim all Your praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion;
verses.9:16: I will exult in Your salvation. The nations have sunk fast in the destruction that they made; in this snare that they hid, their foot has been caught.
verses.9:17: The Lord will be known executing judgments; in the works of his own hands the sinner has been caught.
verses.9:18: Let sinners be turned into hell, all the nations that forget God.
verses.9:19: For there will not be forgetfulness of the poor man to the end; the endurance of the poor will not perish to the end.
verses.9:20: Rise up, Lord; let man not grow strong; let the nations be judged in Your sight.
verses.9:21: Appoint, Lord, a lawgiver over them, so that the nations may know that they are men.
verses.9:22: Why, Lord, have You departed far off; do You look away in times of need, in tribulation?
verses.9:23: While the ungodly one grows proud, the poor man is set on fire; they are caught in the schemes that they devise.
verses.9:24: For the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul, and the unjust man is blessed.
verses.9:25: The sinner has provoked the Lord; according to the multitude of his anger, he will not seek.
verses.9:26: God is not in his sight; his ways are defiled at all times. Your judgments are removed from before his face; he will have dominion over all his enemies.
verses.9:27: For he has said in his heart, "I will not be moved from generation to generation, without evil."
verses.9:28: His mouth is full of cursing, and bitterness, and deceit; under his tongue are toil and pain.
verses.9:29: He sits in ambush with the rich in hidden places, so that he may kill the innocent.
verses.9:30: His eyes look upon the poor man; he lies in ambush in a concealed place, like a lion in his den. He lies in ambush to seize the poor man; to seize the poor man while he draws him in.
verses.9:31: In his snare he will bring him low; he will bow himself down and fall when he has gained dominion over the poor.
verses.9:32: For he has said in his heart, "God has forgotten; He has turned away His face so that He will not see to the end."
verses.9:33: Rise up, Lord God; let Your hand be lifted up; do not forget the poor.
verses.9:34: For what reason has the ungodly one provoked God? For he has said in his heart, "He will not inquire."
verses.9:35: You see, for You consider toil and pain, so that You may deliver them into Your hands. To You the poor man has been left; to the orphan You will be a helper.
verses.9:36: Crush the arm of the sinner and the evildoer; his sin will be sought, and it will not be found.
verses.9:37: The Lord will reign forever, and for age upon age; you will perish, nations, from His land.
verses.9:38: The Lord has heard the desire of the poor; Your ear has heard the preparation of their heart,
verses.9:39: to judge for the fatherless and the humble, so that man may no longer continue to magnify himself upon the earth.
verses.10:1: To the end. A psalm of David.
verses.10:2: For look, sinners have drawn the bow; they have prepared their arrows in the quiver, so that in the dark they may shoot the upright in heart.
verses.10:3: For what You have perfected, they have destroyed; but the righteous one, what has he done?
verses.10:4: The Lord is in His holy temple; the Lord, His throne is in heaven. His eyes look toward the poor; His eyelids question the sons of men.
verses.10:5: The Lord questions the righteous and the ungodly; but the one who loves iniquity hates his own soul.
verses.10:6: He will rain snares upon sinners; fire and sulfur, and a wind of storms, will be the portion of their cup.
verses.10:7: For the Lord is righteous, and He has loved righteous deeds; His face has seen equity.
verses.11:1: To the end, for the eighth. A psalm of David.
verses.11:2: Save me, Lord, for the holy one has vanished, for truths have been diminished from among the sons of men.
verses.11:3: They have spoken empty things, each one to his neighbor; with deceitful lips, in heart and heart they have spoken.
verses.11:4: May the Lord utterly destroy all deceitful lips and the boastful tongue,
verses.11:5: those who have said, "We will magnify our tongue; our lips are from us. Who is our master?"
verses.11:6: "Because of the misery of the needy and the groaning of the poor, now I will rise up," says the Lord. "I will place them in salvation; I will act confidently in it."
verses.11:7: The utterances of the Lord are pure utterances; silver tested by fire, proven to the earth, purified sevenfold.
verses.11:8: You, Lord, will preserve us, and You will guard us from this generation forever.
verses.11:9: The ungodly walk all around; according to Your height, You have multiplied the sons of men.
verses.12:2: To the end. A psalm of David. How long, Lord, will You forget me to the end? How long do You turn Your face away from me?
verses.12:3: How long will I place counsels in my soul, sorrow in my heart throughout the day?
verses.12:4: Look, and hear me, Lord my God. Enlighten my eyes, so that I may never fall asleep in death;
verses.12:5: so that my enemy may never say, "I have prevailed against him." Those who afflict me will exult if I am moved;
verses.12:6: but I have hoped in Your mercy. My heart will exult in Your salvation. I will sing to the Lord, who has granted good things to me; and I will sing psalms to the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.13:1: To the end. A psalm of David. The foolish one has said in his heart, "There is no God." They have been corrupted, and they have become detestable in their pursuits; there is no one who does good, there is not even one.
verses.13:2: The Lord has looked down from heaven on the sons of men, to see whether there is anyone who understands, or anyone who seeks God.
verses.13:3: All of them have turned away; together they have become useless. There is no one who does good, there is not even one. An open tomb is their throat; with their tongues they kept acting deceitfully. The venom of asps is beneath their lips, whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness; swift are their feet to shed blood. Ruin and wretchedness are in their ways, and they have not known the way of peace; no fear of God is before their eyes.
verses.13:4: Will they not come to know, all who practice iniquity, who devour My people like a meal of bread?
verses.13:5: They did not call on the Lord; there they trembled with fear, where there was no fear.
verses.13:6: For the Lord is in the righteous generation. You have put to shame the plan of the needy one, because the Lord is his hope.
verses.13:7: Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When the Lord turns away the captivity of His people, Jacob will exult, and Israel will be glad.
verses.14:1: A psalm of David. Lord, who will dwell in Your tabernacle? Or who will rest on Your holy mountain?
verses.14:2: The one who walks without blemish and practices righteousness;
verses.14:3: who speaks truth in his heart; who has not committed deceit with his tongue, nor done evil to his neighbor, and has not accepted a reproach against his neighbors.
verses.14:4: The wicked one is reduced to nothing in his sight, but he honors those who fear the Lord. The one who swears to his neighbor and does not deceive;
verses.14:5: who has not given his money at interest and has not accepted bribes against an innocent person: the one who does these things will never be moved.
verses.15:1: An inscription of a title, for David himself. Preserve me, Lord, for I have hoped in You.
verses.15:2: I said to the Lord, "You are my God, because You have no need of my good things."
verses.15:3: For the holy ones who are in His land, He has made all my desires marvelous in them.
verses.15:4: Their weaknesses were multiplied; afterward they hurried. I will not assemble their gatherings of blood, nor will I recall their names through my lips.
verses.15:5: The Lord is the share of my inheritance and of my cup; You are the One who will restore my inheritance to me.
verses.15:6: The cords have fallen to me in splendid places; for indeed my inheritance is splendid to me.
verses.15:7: I will bless the Lord, who has granted me understanding; moreover, even until night my kidneys have reproved me.
verses.15:8: I kept seeing the Lord before my sight always, because He is at my right hand, so that I will not be shaken.
verses.15:9: For this reason my heart was glad, and my tongue exulted; moreover, even my flesh will rest in hope.
verses.15:11: For You will not abandon my soul in the underworld, nor will You permit Your Holy One to see corruption. You have made the ways of life known to me; You will fill me with gladness with Your countenance; delights are in Your right hand even to the end.
verses.16:1: A prayer of David. Hear my righteousness, Lord; pay attention to my supplication. Receive my prayer with Your ears, not from deceitful lips.
verses.16:2: From Your face may my judgment go forth; may Your eyes see what is equitable.
verses.16:3: You have tested my heart and visited me by night; You have examined me by fire, and no iniquity has been found in me.
verses.16:4: So that my mouth may not speak of the deeds of men: because of the words of Your lips, I have kept hard ways.
verses.16:5: Perfect my steps in Your paths, so that my footsteps may not be moved.
verses.16:6: I have cried out, because You have heard me, God; incline Your ear to me, and hear my words.
verses.16:7: Make Your mercies wondrous, You who save those who hope in You.
verses.16:8: From those who resist Your right hand, keep me like the pupil of the eye. Under the shadow of Your wings protect me
verses.16:9: from the face of the wicked who have afflicted me. My enemies have surrounded my soul;
verses.16:10: they have closed up their fat: their mouth has spoken pride.
verses.16:11: Casting me out, they have now surrounded me; they have set their eyes to bend down to the earth.
verses.16:12: They have taken hold of me like a lion ready for prey, and like a young lion dwelling in hidden places.
verses.16:13: Rise up, Lord: confront him and overthrow him; rescue my soul from the wicked one; Your sword
verses.16:14: from the enemies of Your hand. Lord, from the few of the earth divide them in their life; from Your hidden things their belly has been filled. They have been satisfied with children, and they have left their remainder to their little ones.
verses.16:15: But in righteousness I will appear in Your sight; I will be satisfied when Your glory appears.
verses.17:1: To the end. For the Lord's servant David, who spoke to the Lord the words of this song on the day when the Lord rescued him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul, and he said:
verses.17:2: I will love You, Lord, my strength.
verses.17:3: The Lord is my stronghold, and my refuge, and my deliverer. My God is my helper, and I will hope in Him; my protector, and the horn of my salvation, and my upholder.
verses.17:4: Praising, I will call upon the Lord, and from my enemies I will be saved.
verses.17:5: The pains of death surrounded me, and the torrents of iniquity threw me into turmoil.
verses.17:6: The pains of the underworld surrounded me; the snares of death overtook me.
verses.17:7: In my tribulation I called upon the Lord, and to my God I cried out: and He heard my voice from His holy temple; and my cry in His sight entered into His ears.
verses.17:8: The earth was shaken and trembled; the foundations of the mountains were thrown into turmoil and were shaken, because He was angry with them.
verses.17:9: Smoke rose up in His anger, and fire blazed forth from His face; coals were kindled by Him.
verses.17:10: He inclined the heavens and descended, and thick darkness was under His feet.
verses.17:11: And He mounted upon the cherubim and flew; He flew upon the wings of the winds.
verses.17:12: And He made darkness His hiding place; around Him was His tent, dark water in the clouds of the air.
verses.17:13: Because of the brightness in His sight the clouds passed by; hail and coals of fire.
verses.17:14: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave forth His voice: hail and coals of fire.
verses.17:15: And He sent out His arrows and scattered them; He multiplied lightning bolts and threw them into turmoil.
verses.17:16: And the springs of the waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were uncovered, at Your rebuke, Lord, at the blast of the breath of Your anger.
verses.17:17: He sent from on high and took me; and He took me up out of many waters.
verses.17:18: He rescued me from my strongest enemies, and from those who hate me. For they grew stronger than me;
verses.17:19: they confronted me on the day of my affliction, and the Lord became my protector.
verses.17:20: And He brought me out into a wide place; He saved me, because He desired me,
verses.17:21: and the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands He will repay me:
verses.17:22: because I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not acted wickedly away from my God;
verses.17:23: for all His judgments are in my sight, and His righteous decrees I have not cast away from me.
verses.17:24: And I will be blameless with Him, and I will guard myself from my iniquity.
verses.17:25: And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands in the sight of His eyes.
verses.17:26: With the holy one You will be holy, and with an innocent man You will be innocent,
verses.17:27: and with the chosen one You will be chosen, and with the perverse one You will act perversely.
verses.17:28: For You will save a humble people, and You will humble the eyes of the proud.
verses.17:29: For You light up my lamp, Lord; my God, light up my darkness.
verses.17:30: For in You I will be rescued from temptation; and in my God I will cross over a wall.
verses.17:31: My God, His way is undefiled; the utterances of the Lord are examined by fire: He is the protector of all who hope in Him.
verses.17:32: For who is a god besides the Lord? Or who is a god besides our God?
verses.17:33: God, who has equipped me with strength and made my way blameless;
verses.17:34: who has perfected my feet like those of deer, and sets me upon high places;
verses.17:35: who teaches my hands for battle. And You have made my arms like a bronze bow,
verses.17:36: and You have given me the protection of Your salvation: and Your right hand has upheld me, and Your discipline has corrected me to the end, and Your discipline itself will teach me.
verses.17:37: You have widened my steps beneath me, and my footsteps have not grown weak.
verses.17:38: I will pursue my enemies and overtake them; and I will not turn back until they fail.
verses.17:39: I will shatter them, and they will not be able to stand; they will fall beneath my feet.
verses.17:40: And You have equipped me with strength for war, and You have overthrown beneath me those who rise up against me.
verses.17:41: And You have made my enemies turn their backs to me, and those who hate me You have destroyed.
verses.17:42: They cried out, and there was no one to save them; to the Lord, and He did not hear them.
verses.17:43: And I will grind them fine like dust before the face of the wind; like the mud of the streets I will wipe them out.
verses.17:44: You will rescue me from the disputes of the people; You will appoint me as head of the nations.
verses.17:45: A people whom I did not know served me; at the hearing of the ear they obeyed me.
verses.17:46: Foreign sons have lied to me, foreign sons have grown old, and they have limped from their paths.
verses.17:47: The Lord lives, and blessed is my God, and may the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.17:48: God, You who give acts of vengeance to me and subdue peoples under me; my deliverer from my wrathful enemies.
verses.17:49: And above those who rise up against me You will exalt me; from the unjust man You will rescue me.
verses.17:50: Therefore I will give thanks to You among the nations, Lord, and to Your name I will sing a psalm;
verses.17:51: magnifying the acts of salvation of His king, and showing mercy to His anointed, David, and to his seed forever.
verses.18:1: To the end. A psalm of David.
verses.18:2: The heavens recount the glory of God, and the expanse announces the works of His hands.
verses.18:3: Day pours out a word to day, and night discloses knowledge to night.
verses.18:4: There are no speeches, nor sayings, whose voices are not heard.
verses.18:5: Into all the earth their sound has gone out, and their words to the ends of the world.
verses.18:6: In the sun He has set His tent, and he is like a bridegroom coming out of his bridal chamber; he has exulted like a giant to run the course;
verses.18:7: from the end of heaven is his going out. And his circuit extends all the way to its end, and there is no one who hides himself from his heat.
verses.18:8: The law of the Lord is unblemished, turning souls back; the testimony of the Lord is trustworthy, bestowing wisdom on little ones.
verses.18:9: The righteous decrees of the Lord are upright, gladdening hearts; the precept of the Lord is bright, illuminating the eyes.
verses.18:10: The fear of the Lord is holy, abiding forever and ever; the judgments of the Lord are true, vindicated in themselves,
verses.18:11: desirable beyond gold and much precious stone, and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.18:12: For indeed Your servant keeps them; in keeping them there is abundant reward.
verses.18:13: Who discerns offenses? Cleanse me from my hidden ones;
verses.18:14: and spare Your servant from strangers. If they have not ruled over me, then I will be unblemished, and I will be thoroughly cleansed from the greatest offense.
verses.18:15: And the utterances of my mouth and the meditation of my heart will be pleasing in Your sight always, Lord, my helper and my redeemer.
verses.19:1: To the end. A psalm of David.
verses.19:2: May the Lord hear you in the day of distress; may the name of the God of Jacob shield you.
verses.19:3: May He send you help from the sanctuary, and guard you from Zion.
verses.19:4: May He be mindful of every sacrifice of yours, and may your burnt offering become fat.
verses.19:5: May He grant you according to your heart, and confirm every plan of yours.
verses.19:6: We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will be magnified.
verses.19:7: May the Lord fulfill all your requests; now I know that the Lord has saved His anointed one. He will hear him from His holy heaven; in mighty deeds is the salvation of His right hand.
verses.19:8: Some in chariots, and some in horses; but we will call out in the name of the Lord our God.
verses.19:9: They themselves were bound and fell; but we rose and were raised upright.
verses.19:10: Lord, save the king, and hear us on the day when we call upon You.
verses.20:1: To the end. A psalm of David.
verses.20:2: Lord, in Your strength the king will rejoice, and over Your salvation he will exult exceedingly.
verses.20:3: You granted him the desire of his heart, and You did not deprive him of the wish of his lips.
verses.20:4: For You went before him with blessings of sweetness; You set on his head a crown of precious stone.
verses.20:5: He asked life from You, and You granted him length of days, forever, and forever and ever.
verses.20:6: Great is his glory in Your salvation; glory and great splendor You will place upon him.
verses.20:7: For You will give him as a blessing forever and ever; You will gladden him in joy with Your face.
verses.20:8: For the king hopes in the Lord, and in the mercy of the Most High he will not be shaken.
verses.20:9: May Your hand be found by all Your enemies; may Your right hand find all who hate You.
verses.20:10: You will make them like a fiery oven in the time of Your face: the Lord in His anger will confound them, and fire will devour them.
verses.20:11: You will destroy their fruit from the earth, and their seed from the sons of men,
verses.20:12: because they turned evils against You; they devised plans that they could not establish.
verses.20:13: For You will make them turn their backs; in Your remnants You will make ready their faces.
verses.20:14: Be exalted, Lord, in Your strength; we will sing and chant Your mighty deeds.
verses.21:1: For the end, for the morning support. A psalm of David.
verses.21:2: God, my God, look upon me: why have You abandoned me? Far from my salvation are the words of my offenses.
verses.21:3: My God, I will cry out by day, and You will not hear; and by night, and not to foolishness for me.
verses.21:4: Yet You dwell in the sanctuary, the praise of Israel.
verses.21:5: In You our fathers hoped; they hoped, and You delivered them.
verses.21:6: To You they cried out and were saved; in You they hoped and were not put to shame.
verses.21:7: But I am a worm, and not a man; a reproach of men and a castoff of the people.
verses.21:8: All who saw me mocked me; they spoke with their lips and shook their heads.
verses.21:9: "He hoped in the Lord; let Him rescue him. Let Him save him, since He desires him."
verses.21:10: For You are the One who drew me out from the womb, my hope from my mother's breasts.
verses.21:11: Upon You I was cast from the womb; from my mother's womb You are my God.
verses.21:12: Do not depart from me, for distress is near, for there is no one to help.
verses.21:13: Many calves have surrounded me; fat bulls have besieged me.
verses.21:14: They have opened their mouth against me, like a tearing and roaring lion.
verses.21:15: Like water I have been poured out, and all my bones have been scattered; my heart has become like melting wax in the midst of my belly.
verses.21:16: My strength has dried up like baked clay, and my tongue has clung to my throat; and into the dust of death You have brought me down.
verses.21:17: For many dogs have surrounded me; a council of evildoers has besieged me. They have pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.21:18: They have counted all my bones. Indeed, they themselves observed and stared at me.
verses.21:19: They divided my garments among themselves, and over my garment they cast lots.
verses.21:20: But You, Lord, do not keep Your help far from me; look to my defense.
verses.21:21: Rescue my soul from the sword, God, and my only one from the hand of the dog.
verses.21:22: Save me from the mouth of the lion, and my lowliness from the horns of unicorns.
verses.21:23: I will declare Your name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will praise You.
verses.21:24: You who fear the Lord, praise Him; all the offspring of Jacob, glorify Him.
verses.21:25: Let all the offspring of Israel fear Him, for He has not disdained nor despised the plea of the poor, nor has He turned His face away from me; and when I cried out to Him, He heard me.
verses.21:26: With You is my praise in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows in the sight of those who fear Him.
verses.21:27: The poor will eat and be satisfied, and those who seek Him will praise the Lord; their hearts will live forever and ever.
verses.21:28: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, and all the families of the nations will worship in His sight,
verses.21:29: for the kingdom belongs to the Lord, and He Himself will rule over the nations.
verses.21:30: All the fat ones of the earth have eaten and worshiped; in His sight all who go down into the earth will fall.
verses.21:31: And my soul will live for Him, and my offspring will serve Him.
verses.21:32: The generation to come will be proclaimed to the Lord, and the heavens will proclaim His righteousness to a people that will be born, whom the Lord has made.
verses.22:1: A psalm of David. The Lord rules me, and nothing will be lacking to me;
verses.22:2: in a place of pasture, there He has settled me. Beside the water of refreshment He has nourished me;
verses.22:3: He has restored my soul. He has led me along paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
verses.22:4: For even if I walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will not fear evils, because You are with me. Your rod and Your staff, they themselves have comforted me.
verses.22:5: You have prepared a table in my sight against those who afflict me; You have richly anointed my head with oil, and my intoxicating cup, how splendid it is!
verses.22:6: And Your mercy will follow closely after me all the days of my life, and so that I may dwell in the house of the Lord for length of days.
verses.23:1: On the first day of the week. A psalm of David. To the Lord belong the earth and its fullness, the world and all who dwell in it.
verses.23:2: For He Himself founded it upon the seas and prepared it upon the rivers.
verses.23:3: Who will ascend to the mountain of the Lord? Or who will stand in His holy place?
verses.23:4: One innocent in hands and pure in heart, who has not received his soul in vain, nor sworn with deceit to his neighbor:
verses.23:5: this one will receive a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from God his Savior.
verses.23:6: This is the generation of those who seek Him, of those who seek the face of the God of Jacob.
verses.23:7: Lift up your gates, princes, and be raised up, eternal gates, and the King of glory will enter.
verses.23:8: Who is this King of glory? The Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord, mighty in battle.
verses.23:9: Lift up your gates, princes, and be raised up, eternal gates, and the King of glory will enter.
verses.23:10: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, He Himself is the King of glory.
verses.24:1: For the end. A psalm of David. To You, Lord, I have lifted up my soul.
verses.24:2: My God, in You I trust; may I not be ashamed.
verses.24:3: Nor let my enemies deride me; for indeed, all who wait for You will not be put to shame.
verses.24:4: Let all who act wickedly without cause be put to shame. Show me Your ways, Lord, and instruct me in Your paths.
verses.24:5: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are God my Savior, and for You I have waited all day long.
verses.24:6: Remember Your acts of compassion, Lord, and Your mercies that are from eternity.
verses.24:7: Do not remember the offenses of my youth and my acts of ignorance. According to Your mercy, You Yourself remember me, on account of Your goodness, Lord.
verses.24:8: Sweet and upright is the Lord; for this reason He will give a law to those who offend in the way.
verses.24:9: He will guide the gentle in judgment; He will teach the meek His ways.
verses.24:10: All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth for those who seek His covenant and His testimonies.
verses.24:11: On account of Your name, Lord, You will pardon my sin, for it is great.
verses.24:12: Who is the man who fears the Lord? He has established a law for him in the way that he has chosen.
verses.24:13: His soul will dwell in good things, and his offspring will inherit the earth.
verses.24:14: The Lord is a firm support for those who fear Him, and His covenant is to be revealed to them.
verses.24:15: My eyes are always toward the Lord, for He Himself will pull my feet out of the snare.
verses.24:16: Look upon me and have mercy on me, for I am solitary and poor.
verses.24:17: The distresses of my heart have multiplied; rescue me from my hardships.
verses.24:18: See my lowliness and my toil, and forgive all my offenses.
verses.24:19: Look upon my enemies, for they have multiplied, and they hate me with an unjust hatred.
verses.24:20: Guard my soul and rescue me; may I not be ashamed, for I have hoped in You.
verses.24:21: The innocent and the upright have clung to me, because I have waited for You.
verses.24:22: Deliver Israel, God, from all its distresses.
verses.25:1: To the end. A psalm of David. Judge me, Lord, because I have walked in my innocence, and, hoping in the Lord, I will not grow weak.
verses.25:2: Examine me, Lord, and test me; burn my kidneys and my heart.
verses.25:3: For Your mercy is before my eyes, and I have taken delight in Your truth.
verses.25:4: I have not sat with a council of vanity, and I will not enter with those who carry out unjust things.
verses.25:5: I have hated the assembly of those who do evil, and I will not sit with the ungodly.
verses.25:6: I will wash my hands among the innocent, and I will go around Your altar, Lord,
verses.25:7: so that I may hear the voice of praise and recount all Your wonders.
verses.25:8: Lord, I have loved the beauty of Your house and the dwelling place of Your glory.
verses.25:9: Do not destroy my soul with the ungodly, God, nor my life with men of blood,
verses.25:10: in whose hands are iniquities; their right hand is filled with bribes.
verses.25:11: But I have walked in my innocence; redeem me, and have mercy on me.
verses.25:12: My foot has stood on straight ground; in the assemblies I will bless You, Lord.
verses.26:1: A psalm of David, before he was anointed. The Lord is my illumination and my salvation; whom will I fear? The Lord is the protector of my life; before whom will I tremble?
verses.26:2: While those who do harm draw near against me to eat my flesh, my enemies who afflict me, they themselves have grown weak and fallen.
verses.26:3: If an encampment should take a stand against me, my heart will not fear; if battle should rise up against me, in this I will hope.
verses.26:4: One thing I have requested from the Lord; this I will seek: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, so that I may see the delight of the Lord and visit His temple.
verses.26:5: For He hid me in His tabernacle; in the day of evils He protected me in the hidden place of His tabernacle.
verses.26:6: On a rock He exalted me, and now He has exalted my head above my enemies. I went around and offered in His tabernacle a sacrifice of shouting; I will sing and chant a psalm to the Lord.
verses.26:7: Hear my voice, Lord, with which I cried out to You; have mercy on me, and hear me.
verses.26:8: To You my heart has said, "My face has sought You out; Your face, Lord, I will seek."
verses.26:9: Do not turn Your face away from me; do not turn aside in anger from Your servant. Be my helper; do not abandon me, nor despise me, God, my Savior.
verses.26:10: For my father and my mother have abandoned me, but the Lord has taken me up.
verses.26:11: Set a law for me, Lord, in Your way, and direct me onto a straight path because of my enemies.
verses.26:12: Do not hand me over into the souls of those who afflict me, because unjust witnesses have risen up against me, and iniquity has lied to itself.
verses.26:13: I believe that I will see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.26:14: Await the Lord, act courageously; and let your heart be strengthened, and wait patiently for the Lord.
verses.27:1: A psalm for David himself. To You, Lord, I will cry out; my God, do not be silent toward me; otherwise, if You ever keep quiet toward me, I will become like those descending into the pit.
verses.27:2: Hear the voice of my supplication, Lord, while I pray to You, while I lift up my hands toward Your holy temple.
verses.27:3: Do not drag me along with sinners, and do not destroy me with those who work iniquity, who speak peace with their neighbor, yet evil things are in their hearts.
verses.27:4: Give to them according to their works and according to the wickedness of their schemes. According to the works of their hands render to them; pay back their retribution to them.
verses.27:5: Because they have not understood the works of the Lord and the works of His hands, You will destroy them, and You will not build them up.
verses.27:6: Blessed is the Lord, because He has heard the voice of my supplication.
verses.27:7: The Lord is my helper and my protector; in Him my heart has hoped, and I have been helped; and my flesh has bloomed again, and of my own will I will give thanks to Him.
verses.27:8: The Lord is the strength of His people and the protector of the salvations of His anointed one.
verses.27:9: Save Your people, Lord, and bless Your inheritance; and rule them, and lift them up forever.
verses.28:1: A psalm of David, at the completion of the tabernacle. Bring to the Lord, sons of God; bring to the Lord the young of rams.
verses.28:2: Bring to the Lord glory and honor; bring to the Lord glory for His name; worship the Lord in His holy court.
verses.28:3: The voice of the Lord is over the waters; the God of majesty thundered; the Lord is over many waters.
verses.28:4: The voice of the Lord is in strength; the voice of the Lord is in magnificence.
verses.28:5: The voice of the Lord shattering the cedars, and the Lord will shatter the cedars of Lebanon;
verses.28:6: and He will crush them into pieces like a calf of Lebanon, and the beloved like the young of unicorns.
verses.28:7: The voice of the Lord splitting the flame of fire;
verses.28:8: the voice of the Lord shaking the wilderness, and the Lord will shake the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.28:9: The voice of the Lord preparing the deer, and He will uncover the dense thickets, and in His temple all will speak glory.
verses.28:10: The Lord causes the flood to dwell, and the Lord will sit as king forever.
verses.28:11: The Lord will give strength to His people; the Lord will bless His people in peace.
verses.29:1: A psalm of song, at the dedication of the house of David.
verses.29:2: I will exalt You, Lord, because You have lifted me up, and You have not delighted my enemies over me.
verses.29:3: Lord my God, I cried out to You, and You healed me.
verses.29:4: Lord, You brought up my soul from the underworld; You saved me from those going down into the pit.
verses.29:5: Sing psalms to the Lord, His holy ones, and give thanks to the remembrance of His holiness.
verses.29:6: For anger is in His indignation, and life is in His will; at evening weeping will linger, and at morning, gladness.
verses.29:7: But I said in my abundance, "I will never be moved."
verses.29:8: Lord, in Your will You granted strength to my beauty; You turned Your face away from me, and I became troubled.
verses.29:9: To You, Lord, I will cry out, and to my God I will plead.
verses.29:10: What benefit is there in my blood, while I go down into corruption? Will dust give thanks to You, or declare Your truth?
verses.29:11: The Lord heard and had mercy on me; the Lord became my helper.
verses.29:12: You have turned my mourning into joy for me; You have torn apart my sackcloth and surrounded me with gladness,
verses.29:13: so that my glory may sing to You, and I may not feel compunction. Lord my God, I will give thanks to You forever.
verses.30:1: To the end. A psalm of David, for ecstasy.
verses.30:2: In You, Lord, I have hoped; may I never be put to shame; deliver me in Your righteousness.
verses.30:3: Incline Your ear to me; hurry to rescue me. Be for me a protecting God and a house of refuge, so that You may save me,
verses.30:4: for You are my might and my refuge; and for the sake of Your name You will lead me and nourish me.
verses.30:5: You will bring me out of this snare that they have hidden for me, for You are my protector.
verses.30:6: Into Your hands I entrust my spirit; You have redeemed me, Lord God of truth.
verses.30:7: You hate those who observe vanities uselessly; but I have hoped in the Lord.
verses.30:8: I will exult and be glad in Your mercy, because You have looked upon my lowliness; You have saved my soul from distresses.
verses.30:9: Nor have You shut me up in the hands of the enemy; You have placed my feet in a broad place.
verses.30:10: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am in distress; my eye is troubled in anger, my soul, and my belly.
verses.30:11: For my life has failed in sorrow, and my years in groans. My strength has been weakened in poverty, and my bones are troubled.
verses.30:12: Above all my enemies I have become a reproach, and exceedingly so to my neighbors, and a dread to my acquaintances; those who saw me outside fled from me.
verses.30:13: I have been given to oblivion like a dead man from the heart; I have become like a ruined vessel,
verses.30:14: for I heard the reviling of many dwelling all around. While they gathered together against me, they took counsel to take my soul.
verses.30:15: But I have hoped in You, Lord; I said, "You are my God."
verses.30:16: In Your hands are my lots; rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those who pursue me.
verses.30:17: Cause Your face to shine upon Your servant; save me in Your mercy.
verses.30:18: Lord, may I not be put to shame, for I have called upon You. Let the ungodly be ashamed, and let them be led down into the underworld;
verses.30:19: let deceitful lips become mute, which speak iniquity against the righteous in pride and in scorn.
verses.30:20: How great is the abundance of Your sweetness, Lord, which You have hidden for those who fear You; You have accomplished it for those who hope in You in the sight of the sons of men!
verses.30:21: You will hide them in the hidden place of Your face from the turmoil of men; You will shield them in Your tabernacle from the contradiction of tongues.
verses.30:22: Blessed be the Lord, for He has made His mercy wondrous to me in a fortified city.
verses.30:23: But I said in the consternation of my mind, "I have been cast out from the sight of Your eyes." Therefore You heard the voice of my prayer while I cried out to You.
verses.30:24: Love the Lord, all His holy ones, for the Lord will seek out truth, and He will abundantly repay those who practice pride.
verses.30:25: Act courageously, and let your heart be strengthened, all you who hope in the Lord.
verses.31:1: For David himself, of understanding. Blessed are those whose iniquities have been forgiven, and whose sins have been covered.
verses.31:2: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord has not imputed sin, nor is there deceit in his spirit.
verses.31:3: Because I remained silent, my bones grew old while I was crying out all day.
verses.31:4: Because day and night Your hand weighed heavily upon me, I was turned in my misery while a thorn is driven in.
verses.31:5: I made my offense known to You, and I did not hide my unrighteousness. I said, "I will confess my unrighteousness against myself to the Lord," and You forgave the ungodliness of my sin.
verses.31:6: For this every holy one will pray to You at an opportune time. Nevertheless, in a flood of many waters, they will not come near him.
verses.31:7: You are my refuge from the affliction that has surrounded me; my exultation, rescue me from those who surround me.
verses.31:8: I will give you understanding and instruct you in this way along which you will walk; I will set My eyes firmly upon you.
verses.31:9: Do not become like a horse and a mule, which have no understanding. With muzzle and bridle restrain the jaws of those who do not come near to You.
verses.31:10: Many are the scourges of the sinner, but mercy will surround the one who hopes in the Lord.
verses.31:11: Be glad in the Lord and exult, you righteous, and glory, all you who are upright in heart.
verses.32:1: A psalm of David. Exult, you righteous, in the Lord; praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.32:2: Give thanks to the Lord with the lyre; make melody to Him on a harp of ten strings.
verses.32:3: Sing to Him a new song; make melody well to Him with a loud shout.
verses.32:4: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all His works are in faithfulness.
verses.32:5: He loves mercy and judgment; the earth is full of the Lord's mercy.
verses.32:6: By the word of the Lord the heavens were established, and by the breath of His mouth all their power.
verses.32:7: He gathers the waters of the sea as in a waterskin; He places the deeps in storehouses.
verses.32:8: Let all the earth fear the Lord, and let all who inhabit the world be shaken before Him.
verses.32:9: For He Himself spoke, and they were made; He Himself commanded, and they were created.
verses.32:10: The Lord frustrates the plans of the nations; He rejects the thoughts of the peoples, and He rejects the plans of princes.
verses.32:11: But the plan of the Lord remains forever, the thoughts of His heart from generation to generation.
verses.32:12: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people whom He chose as an inheritance for Himself.
verses.32:13: From heaven the Lord looked down; He saw all the sons of men.
verses.32:14: From His prepared dwelling place He looked out upon all who inhabit the earth,
verses.32:15: He who fashioned their hearts one by one, who understands all their works.
verses.32:16: A king is not saved by great power, and a giant will not be saved by the greatness of his power.
verses.32:17: A horse is deceptive for safety, yet by the abundance of its power it will not be saved.
verses.32:18: Look, the eyes of the Lord are upon those who fear Him, and upon those who hope in His mercy,
verses.32:19: so that He may rescue their souls from death and nourish them in famine.
verses.32:20: Our soul waits for the Lord, because He is our helper and protector.
verses.32:21: For in Him our heart will be glad, and in His holy name we have hoped.
verses.32:22: May Your mercy, Lord, be upon us, just as we have hoped in You.
verses.33:1: For David, when he altered his face before Ahimelech, and he dismissed him, and he departed.
verses.33:2: I will bless the Lord at every time; His praise will always be in my mouth.
verses.33:3: In the Lord my soul will be praised; let the meek hear and be glad.
verses.33:4: Magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt His name as one.
verses.33:5: I sought out the Lord, and He heard me, and out of all my afflictions He rescued me.
verses.33:6: Draw near to Him and be enlightened, and your faces will not be put to shame.
verses.33:7: This poor man cried out, and the Lord heard him, and from all his afflictions He saved him.
verses.33:8: The angel of the Lord will encamp all around those who fear Him and will rescue them.
verses.33:9: Taste and see that the Lord is sweet; blessed is the man who hopes in Him.
verses.33:10: Fear the Lord, all His holy ones, because there is no lack for those who fear Him.
verses.33:11: The rich have been in need and have grown hungry, but those who seek the Lord will not fall short of any good thing.
verses.33:12: Come, children, hear me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
verses.33:13: Who is the man who desires life, who loves to see good days?
verses.33:14: Restrain your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.33:15: Turn aside from evil and do good; seek out peace and pursue it.
verses.33:16: The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and His ears are toward their prayers.
verses.33:17: But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil, so that He may destroy their memory from the earth.
verses.33:18: The righteous cried out, and the Lord heard them, and out of all their afflictions He delivered them.
verses.33:19: The Lord is near to those who are afflicted in heart, and He will save the humble in spirit.
verses.33:20: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, and from all these the Lord will deliver them.
verses.33:21: The Lord guards all their bones; not one of these will be broken.
verses.33:22: The death of sinners is most evil, and those who hate the righteous man will incur guilt.
verses.33:23: The Lord will redeem the souls of His servants, and none of those who hope in Him will incur guilt.
verses.34:1: For David himself. Judge, Lord, those who harm me; attack those who fight against me.
verses.34:2: Seize weapons and shield, and rise up to my aid.
verses.34:3: Pour out the sword, and block the way against those who pursue me; say to my soul, "I am your salvation."
verses.34:4: Let those who seek my soul be disgraced and humiliated; let those who devise evil against me be turned backward and disgraced.
verses.34:5: Let them become like dust before the face of the wind, and may the angel of the Lord hem them in.
verses.34:6: Let their way become darkness and slipperiness, and may the angel of the Lord pursue them.
verses.34:7: For without cause they hid for me the destruction of their snare; needlessly they reproached my soul.
verses.34:8: Let a snare that he does not know come upon him, and let the trap that he hid seize him, and let him fall into that very snare itself.
verses.34:9: But my soul will exult in the Lord and will take delight in His salvation.
verses.34:10: All my bones will say, "Lord, who is like You, rescuing the needy from the hand of those stronger than he, the destitute and the poor from those who plunder him?"
verses.34:11: Rising up, unjust witnesses questioned me about things I did not know.
verses.34:12: They repaid me evil for good, barrenness to my soul.
verses.34:13: But I, when they were troublesome to me, clothed myself with sackcloth; I humbled my soul in fasting, and my prayer will return to my bosom.
verses.34:14: As toward a neighbor and as toward our brother, so I sought to please; as one mourning and sorrowful, so I was humbled.
verses.34:15: And against me they rejoiced and came together; scourges were gathered together upon me, and I did not know.
verses.34:16: They were scattered and felt no remorse; they tested me, they mocked me with mockery; they gnashed at me with their teeth.
verses.34:17: Lord, when will You look? Restore my soul from their malice; from the lions, my only one.
verses.34:18: I will give thanks to You in a great assembly; among a numerous people I will praise You.
verses.34:19: May those who oppose me unjustly not gloat over me, those who hate me without cause and wink with their eyes.
verses.34:20: For to me indeed they were speaking peacefully; and speaking in the wrath of the land, they were devising deceits.
verses.34:21: And they opened wide their mouth against me; they said, "Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen."
verses.34:22: You have seen, Lord; do not be silent; Lord, do not depart from me.
verses.34:23: Rise up and attend to my judgment, my God; and, my Lord, to my cause.
verses.34:24: Judge me according to Your righteousness, Lord my God, and may they not gloat over me.
verses.34:25: Let them not say in their hearts, "Aha, aha, for our soul!" nor let them say, "We have devoured him."
verses.34:26: Let those who celebrate my misfortunes be ashamed and humiliated together; let those who speak great things against me be clothed with disgrace and humiliation.
verses.34:27: Let those who desire my righteousness exult and rejoice; and let those who desire the peace of His servant always say, "May the Lord be magnified."
verses.34:28: And my tongue will meditate on Your righteousness; all day long, Your praise.
verses.35:1: For the end. For the servant of the Lord, David himself.
verses.35:2: The unrighteous man has said within himself that he will transgress: there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.35:3: For he has acted deceitfully in His sight, so that his iniquity may be found hateful.
verses.35:4: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit; he has refused to understand so as to do good.
verses.35:5: He has meditated on iniquity on his bed; he has taken his stand on every way that is not good; yet he has not hated malice.
verses.35:6: Lord, in heaven is Your mercy, and Your truth reaches as far as the clouds.
verses.35:7: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; Your judgments are a vast abyss. Men and beasts You will save, Lord,
verses.35:8: just as You have multiplied Your mercy, God. But the sons of men will hope in the shelter of Your wings.
verses.35:9: They will be intoxicated with the abundance of Your house, and from the torrent of Your delight You will give them to drink:
verses.35:10: for with You is the spring of life, and in Your light we will see light.
verses.35:11: Extend Your mercy to those who know You, and Your righteousness to those who are upright in heart.
verses.35:12: May the foot of pride not come upon me, and may the hand of the sinner not move me.
verses.35:13: There those who practice iniquity fell; they were driven out, and they could not stand.
verses.36:1: A psalm for David himself. Do not be envious of those who do evil, nor be jealous of those who commit iniquity,
verses.36:2: for like grass they will quickly dry up, and just like green herbs they will swiftly fall away.
verses.36:3: Hope in the Lord and do goodness, and dwell in the land, and you will be fed on its riches.
verses.36:4: Take delight in the Lord, and He will give you the petitions of your heart.
verses.36:5: Reveal your way to the Lord and hope in Him, and He Himself will act.
verses.36:6: And He will bring out your righteousness like light, and your judgment like midday.
verses.36:7: Be subject to the Lord and pray to Him. Do not be envious of the one who prospers in his way, of the man who commits injustices.
verses.36:8: Cease from anger and abandon fury; do not be envious so as to do evil.
verses.36:9: For those who do evil will be wiped out, but those who wait patiently for the Lord, they themselves will inherit the land.
verses.36:10: And still a little while, and the sinner will be no more; and you will seek his place, and you will not find it.
verses.36:11: But the gentle will inherit the land, and they will take delight in an abundance of peace.
verses.36:12: The sinner will watch the righteous one closely and will gnash his teeth at him.
verses.36:13: But the Lord will laugh at him, for He foresees that his day will come.
verses.36:14: Sinners have unsheathed the sword; they have bent their bow to bring down the poor and the needy, to slaughter the upright in heart.
verses.36:15: May their sword enter into their own hearts, and may their bow be shattered.
verses.36:16: Better is a little for the righteous one than the abundant riches of sinners,
verses.36:17: for the arms of sinners will be crushed, yet the Lord strengthens the righteous.
verses.36:18: The Lord knows the days of the spotless, and their inheritance will be forever.
verses.36:19: They will not be put to shame in an evil time, and in days of famine they will be satisfied,
verses.36:20: because sinners will perish. Indeed, the enemies of the Lord, as soon as they have been honored and exalted, vanishing just like smoke, they will vanish.
verses.36:21: The sinner will borrow and will not repay, but the righteous one shows mercy and will give,
verses.36:22: for those who bless Him will inherit the land, while those who curse Him will be destroyed.
verses.36:23: With the Lord the steps of a man will be directed, and He will desire his way.
verses.36:24: When he falls, he will not be dashed down, because the Lord places His hand underneath.
verses.36:25: I was young, and indeed I have grown old, and I have not seen the righteous one abandoned, nor his offspring seeking bread.
verses.36:26: All day long he shows mercy and lends, and his offspring will be in blessing.
verses.36:27: Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell forever and ever,
verses.36:28: for the Lord loves judgment and will not abandon His holy ones; they will be preserved forever. The unjust will be punished, and the offspring of the ungodly will perish.
verses.36:29: But the righteous will inherit the land, and they will dwell upon it forever and ever.
verses.36:30: The mouth of the righteous one will meditate on wisdom, and his tongue will speak judgment.
verses.36:31: The law of his God is in his own heart, and his steps will not be tripped up.
verses.36:32: The sinner observes the righteous one and seeks to put him to death.
verses.36:33: But the Lord will not abandon him in his hands, nor will He condemn him when judgment is passed on him.
verses.36:34: Wait for the Lord and keep His way, and He will exalt you so that you may take the land as an inheritance; when sinners perish, you will see it.
verses.36:35: I saw the ungodly one highly exalted and lifted up like the cedars of Lebanon;
verses.36:36: and I passed by, and look, he was no more; and I sought him, and his place was not found.
verses.36:37: Keep innocence and look upon equity, for there is a remnant for a peaceable man.
verses.36:38: But the unjust will be destroyed together; the remnant of the ungodly will perish.
verses.36:39: But the salvation of the righteous is from the Lord, and He is their protector in a time of tribulation.
verses.36:40: And the Lord will help them and deliver them; and He will rescue them from sinners and save them, because they have hoped in Him.
verses.37:1: A psalm of David, for remembrance concerning the Sabbath.
verses.37:2: Lord, do not rebuke me in Your fury, nor discipline me in Your anger,
verses.37:3: for Your arrows have been driven into me, and You have pressed Your hand firmly upon me.
verses.37:4: There is no health in my flesh because of Your anger; there is no peace for my bones because of my sins,
verses.37:5: for my iniquities have passed over my head, and like a heavy burden they have weighed heavily upon me.
verses.37:6: My scars have festered and decayed because of my foolishness.
verses.37:7: I have become wretched and bowed down even to the end; all day long I went about saddened.
verses.37:8: For my loins are filled with mockeries, and there is no health in my flesh.
verses.37:9: I have been afflicted and exceedingly humbled; I roared from the groaning of my heart.
verses.37:10: Lord, before You is all my desire, and my groaning is not hidden from You.
verses.37:11: My heart is deeply troubled; my strength has abandoned me, and the light of my eyes, even that is not with me.
verses.37:12: My friends and my neighbors drew near against me and stood, and those who were near me stood far off; and those who were seeking my life were using violence.
verses.37:13: And those who sought out evils for me spoke vanities, and they meditated on deceits all day long.
verses.37:14: But I, like a deaf man, did not hear, and like a mute man not opening his mouth.
verses.37:15: And I became like a man not hearing, and having no rebuttals in his mouth.
verses.37:16: For in You, Lord, I have hoped; You will hear me, Lord my God.
verses.37:17: For I said, "May my enemies never rejoice over me"; and while my feet are shaken, they have spoken great things against me.
verses.37:18: For I am ready for scourges, and my pain is in my sight always.
verses.37:19: For I will declare my iniquity, and I will take thought for my sin.
verses.37:20: But my enemies live and have grown strong over me, and those who hate me unjustly have been multiplied.
verses.37:21: Those who repay evil for good were slandering me, because I was pursuing goodness.
verses.37:22: Do not abandon me, Lord my God; do not depart from me.
verses.37:23: Attend to my help, Lord God of my salvation.
verses.38:1: For the end, for Jeduthun himself. A song of David.
verses.38:2: I said, "I will guard my ways, so that I may not sin with my tongue." I placed a guard over my mouth while the sinner stood against me.
verses.38:3: I became mute and was humbled, and I kept silent from good things; and my pain was renewed.
verses.38:4: My heart grew hot within me, and in my meditation a fire will blaze up.
verses.38:5: I spoke with my tongue, "Make known to me, Lord, my end, and what the number of my days is, so that I may know what is lacking to me.
verses.38:6: Look, You have made my days measurable, and my substance is as nothing before You. Indeed, every living man is complete vanity.
verses.38:7: Indeed, man passes through in an image; yet he is also troubled in vain: he stores up treasures, and does not know for whom he will gather them.
verses.38:8: And now, what is my expectation? Is it not the Lord? And my substance is with You.
verses.38:9: Rescue me from all my iniquities; You have made me a reproach to the fool.
verses.38:10: I became mute and did not open my mouth, because You did it;
verses.38:12: From the strength of Your hand I have fainted in rebukes: because of iniquity You have disciplined man. And You have made his soul waste away like a spider; indeed, every man is troubled in vain.
verses.38:13: Hear my prayer, Lord, and my supplication; give ear to my tears. Do not be silent, because I am a foreigner with You and a traveler, like all my fathers.
verses.38:14: Relent toward me, so that I may be refreshed before I depart and will be no more."
verses.39:1: For the end. A psalm for David himself.
verses.39:2: Waiting, I waited for the Lord, and He attended to me.
verses.39:3: And He heard my prayers, and led me out of the pit of misery and out of the mud of sediment. And He set my feet on a rock, and directed my steps.
verses.39:4: And He put a new song into my mouth, a hymn to our God. Many will see and will fear, and will hope in the Lord.
verses.39:5: Blessed is the man whose hope is the name of the Lord, and who has not looked toward vanities and false follies.
verses.39:6: Many are Your wonders that You have done, Lord my God, and in Your thoughts there is no one who is like You. I have proclaimed and spoken: they have been multiplied beyond number.
verses.39:7: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but You perfected ears for me. A burnt offering and a sin offering You did not demand;
verses.39:8: then I said, "Look, I come. At the head of the book it is written about me,
verses.39:9: that I should do Your will. My God, I have desired it, and Your law is in the midst of my heart."
verses.39:10: I have proclaimed Your righteousness in the great assembly; look, I will not restrain my lips: Lord, You know.
verses.39:11: I have not hidden Your righteousness in my heart; I have spoken of Your truth and Your salvation; I have not hidden Your mercy and Your truth from the vast council.
verses.39:12: But You, Lord, do not keep Your compassions far from me; Your mercy and Your truth have always upheld me.
verses.39:13: For evils that have no number have surrounded me; my iniquities have seized me, and I was not able to see. They have been multiplied beyond the hairs of my head, and my heart has abandoned me.
verses.39:14: May it please You, Lord, to rescue me; Lord, look to help me.
verses.39:15: May they be put to shame and humiliated together, those who seek my soul to take it away; may they be turned backward and humiliated, those who wish evil for me.
verses.39:16: May they immediately bear their shame, those who say to me, "Aha, aha!"
verses.39:17: May all who seek You exult and be glad in You; and may those who love Your salvation always say, "May the Lord be magnified."
verses.39:18: But I am a beggar and poor; the Lord is concerned for me. You are my helper and my protector; my God, do not delay.
verses.40:1: For the end. A psalm for David himself.
verses.40:2: Blessed is the one who has understanding for the needy and the poor: in the evil day the Lord will deliver him.
verses.40:3: May the Lord preserve him, and give him life, and make him blessed on the earth, and not hand him over to the soul of his enemies.
verses.40:4: May the Lord bring help to him on his bed of pain; You have turned all his bedding in his sickness.
verses.40:5: I said, "Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, because I have sinned against You."
verses.40:6: My enemies spoke evil against me, "When will he die, and his name perish?"
verses.40:7: And if he came in to see, he spoke empty things; his heart gathered iniquity to itself. He went outside and spoke.
verses.40:8: Together, all my enemies were whispering against me; against me they were devising evil for me.
verses.40:9: They decreed an unjust word against me: "Will the one who sleeps rise up no more?"
verses.40:10: For even the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has magnified treachery against me.
verses.40:11: But You, Lord, have mercy on me, and raise me up; and I will repay them.
verses.40:12: By this I know that You have favored me, because my enemy will not rejoice over me.
verses.40:13: But You have upheld me because of innocence, and You have established me in Your sight forever.
verses.40:14: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, from eternity and even to eternity. Let it be so, let it be so.
verses.41:1: To the end. Understanding for the sons of Korah.
verses.41:2: Just as a deer longs for the springs of water, so my soul longs for You, God.
verses.41:3: My soul has thirsted for the strong, living God; when will I come and appear before the face of God?
verses.41:4: My tears have been bread for me day and night, while it is said to me daily, "Where is your God?"
verses.41:5: I remembered these things and poured out my soul within me, for I will pass over into the place of the wonderful tabernacle, all the way to the house of God, with a voice of exultation and thanksgiving, the sound of one feasting.
verses.41:6: Why are you sorrowful, my soul? And why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I will still give thanks to Him, the salvation of my face,
verses.41:7: and my God. Within myself my soul has been troubled; therefore I will be mindful of You from the land of the Jordan and Hermonim, from the small mountain.
verses.41:8: Abyss calls upon abyss at the voice of Your waterfalls; all Your heights and Your waves have passed over me.
verses.41:9: By day the Lord has commanded His mercy, and by night His song; with me is a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.41:10: I will say to God, "You are my protector; why have You forgotten me? And why do I walk about saddened, while the enemy afflicts me?"
verses.41:11: While my bones are being broken, my enemies who distress me have reproached me, while they say to me day by day, "Where is your God?"
verses.41:12: Why are you sorrowful, my soul? And why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I will still give thanks to Him, the salvation of my face, and my God.
verses.42:1: A psalm of David. Judge me, God, and separate my case from an unholy nation; rescue me from an unjust and deceitful man.
verses.42:2: For You, God, are my strength; why have You rejected me? And why do I walk about sorrowful, while the enemy afflicts me?
verses.42:3: Send out Your light and Your truth; they themselves have led me and brought me to Your holy mountain and into Your tabernacles.
verses.42:4: And I will go in to the altar of God, to God, who gladdens my youth. I will give thanks to You on the lyre, God, my God.
verses.42:5: Why are you sorrowful, my soul? And why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I will still give thanks to Him, the salvation of my face, and my God.
verses.43:1: To the end. For the sons of Korah, for understanding.
verses.43:2: God, with our ears we have heard; our fathers have declared to us the work that You worked in their days and in ancient days.
verses.43:3: Your hand destroyed the nations, and You planted them; You afflicted the peoples and drove them out.
verses.43:4: For they did not possess the land by their sword, and their arm did not save them; but Your right hand and Your arm, and the illumination of Your face, because You were well pleased with them.
verses.43:5: You Yourself are my King and my God, who command the deliverances of Jacob.
verses.43:6: In You we will toss our enemies with the horn, and in Your name we will spurn those who rise up against us.
verses.43:7: For I will not hope in my bow, and my sword will not save me;
verses.43:8: for You have saved us from those who afflict us, and You have put to shame those who hate us.
verses.43:9: In God we will be praised all day long, and in Your name we will give thanks forever.
verses.43:10: But now You have rejected us and put us to shame, and You will not go out, God, with our armies.
verses.43:11: You have turned us backward behind our enemies, and those who hate us were plundering for themselves.
verses.43:12: You have given us like sheep for food, and You have scattered us among the nations.
verses.43:13: You have sold Your people without a price, and there was no abundance in their exchanges.
verses.43:14: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and a derision to those who are all around us.
verses.43:15: You have made us a comparison to the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.43:16: All day long my disgrace is before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
verses.43:17: from the voice of one who reproaches and reviles, from the face of the enemy and persecutor.
verses.43:18: All these things have come upon us, and we have not forgotten You, and we have not acted unjustly in Your covenant.
verses.43:19: And our heart has not drawn back, and You have turned aside our paths from Your way,
verses.43:20: because You have humbled us in the place of affliction, and the shadow of death has covered us.
verses.43:21: If we have forgotten the name of our God, and if we have stretched out our hands to a foreign god,
verses.43:23: will God not search out these things? For He Himself knows the hidden things of the heart. Because for Your sake we are put to death all day long; we have been reckoned like sheep for slaughter.
verses.43:24: Arise; why do You sleep, Lord? Arise, and do not reject us forever.
verses.43:25: Why do You turn Your face away? Do You forget our poverty and our distress?
verses.43:26: For our soul has been humbled in the dust; our belly has clung fast to the earth.
verses.43:27: Arise, Lord, help us, and redeem us for the sake of Your name.
verses.44:1: To the end, for those who will be changed. For the sons of Korah, for understanding. A song for the beloved.
verses.44:2: My heart has poured forth a good word; I myself speak my works to the king. My tongue is the reed pen of a scribe writing swiftly.
verses.44:3: You are handsome in form above the sons of men; grace has been poured out on Your lips; therefore God has blessed You forever.
verses.44:4: Gird Yourself with Your sword upon Your thigh, most mighty One.
verses.44:5: In Your splendor and Your beauty, press on, go forth prosperously, and reign, for the sake of truth, gentleness, and righteousness; and Your right hand will lead You wonderfully.
verses.44:6: Your arrows are sharp; peoples will fall beneath You, into the hearts of the king's enemies.
verses.44:7: Your throne, God, is forever and ever; a scepter of rectitude is the scepter of Your kingdom.
verses.44:8: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with oil of gladness above Your companions.
verses.44:9: Myrrh, stacte, and cassia come from Your garments, from ivory houses, out of which they have delighted You,
verses.44:10: daughters of kings, in Your honor. The queen has taken her stand at Your right hand in gilded attire, wrapped around in varied color.
verses.44:11: Listen, daughter, and see, and incline your ear; and forget your people and the house of your father.
verses.44:12: And the king will desire your beauty, for He Himself is the Lord your God, and they will worship Him.
verses.44:13: And with gifts the daughters of Tyre will implore your face, all the wealthy of the people.
verses.44:14: All the glory of her, the king's daughter, is from within, in golden fringes,
verses.44:15: clothed around in varied colors. Virgins will be led to the king after her; her close companions will be brought to You.
verses.44:16: They will be brought with gladness and exultation; they will be led into the temple of the king.
verses.44:17: In place of Your fathers, sons have been born to You; You will appoint them princes over all the earth.
verses.44:18: They will be mindful of Your name in every generation and generation; therefore the peoples will give praise to You forever, and forever and ever.
verses.45:1: To the end, for the sons of Korah, for hidden things. A psalm.
verses.45:2: Our God is a refuge and strength, a helper in tribulations that have come upon us greatly.
verses.45:3: Therefore we will not fear while the earth is thrown into turmoil, and the mountains are carried into the heart of the sea.
verses.45:4: Their waters resounded and were thrown into turmoil; the mountains were convulsed in its might.
verses.45:5: The rush of the river gladdens the city of God; the Most High has sanctified His tabernacle.
verses.45:6: God is in her midst; she will not be shaken; God will help her early at daybreak.
verses.45:7: The nations were thrown into tumult, and the kingdoms swayed; He gave His voice; the earth was moved.
verses.45:8: The Lord of hosts is with us; our upholder is the God of Jacob.
verses.45:9: Come and see the works of the Lord, what wonders He has set upon the earth,
verses.45:10: taking away wars to the end of the earth. He will shatter the bow and break weapons in pieces, and He will burn up shields with fire.
verses.45:11: "Cease, and see that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, and I will be exalted on the earth."
verses.45:12: The Lord of hosts is with us; our upholder is the God of Jacob.
verses.46:1: To the end, for the sons of Korah. A psalm.
verses.46:2: All nations, clap your hands; shout joyfully to God with a voice of exultation,
verses.46:3: for the Lord is high, fearsome, a great king over all the earth.
verses.46:4: He has subjected peoples to us, and nations beneath our feet.
verses.46:5: He has chosen His inheritance for us, the splendor of Jacob, which He loved.
