verses.46:6: God has ascended with a joyful shout, and the Lord with the voice of a trumpet.
verses.46:7: Sing psalms to our God, sing psalms; sing psalms to our king, sing psalms,
verses.46:8: for God is king of all the earth; sing psalms wisely.
verses.46:9: God will reign over the nations; God sits upon His holy throne.
verses.46:10: The princes of the peoples have been gathered together with the God of Abraham, for the mighty gods of the earth have been greatly lifted up.
verses.47:1: A psalm of song. For the sons of Korah, on the second day of the week.
verses.47:2: Great is the Lord and exceedingly worthy of praise in the city of our God, on His holy mountain.
verses.47:3: Mount Zion is founded with the exultation of the whole earth; the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.47:4: God will be known in her houses when He upholds her.
verses.47:5: For look, the kings of the earth were gathered together; they came together as one.
verses.47:6: They themselves saw and thus marveled; they were thrown into confusion, they were shaken.
verses.47:7: Trembling seized them; there were pains like those of a woman in labor:
verses.47:8: with a violent wind You will shatter the ships of Tarshish.
verses.47:9: Just as we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: God has founded her forever.
verses.47:10: We have received Your mercy, God, in the midst of Your temple.
verses.47:11: According to Your name, God, so also is Your praise to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.47:12: Let Mount Zion be glad, and let the daughters of Judah exult because of Your judgments, Lord.
verses.47:13: Go around Zion and embrace her; tell it in her towers.
verses.47:14: Set your hearts on her strength, and distribute her houses, so that you may recount it in another generation.
verses.47:15: For this is God, our God forever, and for age upon age: He Himself will rule us through the ages.
verses.48:1: To the end, for the sons of Korah. A psalm.
verses.48:2: Hear these things, all nations; take them in with your ears, all you who inhabit the world:
verses.48:3: both the earthborn and the sons of men, together as one, rich and poor.
verses.48:4: My mouth will speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart, prudence.
verses.48:5: I will bend my ear to a parable; I will lay open my riddle with the psaltery.
verses.48:6: Why should I fear in the evil day? The iniquity of my heel will surround me.
verses.48:7: Those who trust in their strength also boast in the abundance of their riches.
verses.48:8: A brother does not redeem, a man will redeem: he will not give to God his propitiation,
verses.48:9: and the price of the redemption of his soul. And he will labor forever;
verses.48:10: and he will still live to the end.
verses.48:11: He will not see destruction when he sees the wise dying: together the senseless and the foolish will perish. And they will leave their riches to strangers,
verses.48:12: and their tombs are their houses forever; their tents through generation and generation: they called their own names on their lands.
verses.48:13: And man, when he was in honor, did not understand. He was compared to senseless beasts, and he became like them.
verses.48:14: This way of theirs is a stumbling block to themselves, and afterward they will take pleasure in their own mouth.
verses.48:15: Like sheep they are placed in the underworld: death will feed on them. And the righteous will have dominion over them in the morning, and their help will grow old in the underworld, away from their glory.
verses.48:16: Nevertheless, God will redeem my soul from the hand of the underworld when He receives me.
verses.48:17: Do not be afraid when a man becomes rich, and when the glory of his house is multiplied:
verses.48:18: for when he dies, he will not take all things, nor will his glory descend with him.
verses.48:19: For his soul will be blessed in his own life; he will praise You when You do good to him.
verses.48:20: He will enter even to the generations of his fathers, and even forever he will not see light.
verses.48:21: Man, when he was in honor, did not understand. He was compared to senseless beasts, and he became like them.
verses.49:1: A psalm of Asaph. The God of gods, the Lord, has spoken and called the earth from the rising of the sun even to its setting.
verses.49:2: Out of Zion is the splendor of His beauty:
verses.49:3: God will come visibly, our God, and He will not be silent. A fire will blaze up in His sight, and all around Him is a mighty storm.
verses.49:4: He will summon heaven from above, and the earth, to judge His people.
verses.49:5: Gather to Him His holy ones, who establish His covenant over sacrifices.
verses.49:6: And the heavens will declare His righteousness, for God is judge.
verses.49:7: "Hear, My people, and I will speak; Israel, and I will testify to you: I am God, your God.
verses.49:8: I will not reprove you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are always in My sight.
verses.49:9: I will not take calves from your house, nor male goats from your flocks:
verses.49:10: for all the wild animals of the forests are Mine, the beasts on the mountains, and the oxen.
verses.49:11: I know all the birds of the sky, and the beauty of the field is with Me.
verses.49:12: If I grow hungry, I will not tell you: for Mine is the world and its fullness.
verses.49:13: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or will I drink the blood of male goats?
verses.49:14: Offer to God a sacrifice of praise, and pay your vows to the Most High.
verses.49:15: And call upon Me in the day of distress: I will deliver you, and you will honor Me."
verses.49:16: But to the sinner God said, "Why do you recount My righteous decrees, and take up My covenant through your mouth?
verses.49:17: Yet you have hated discipline and thrown My words behind you.
verses.49:18: If you saw a thief, you ran with him, and you placed your portion with adulterers.
verses.49:19: Your mouth abounded with malice, and your tongue crafted deceits.
verses.49:20: Sitting, you spoke against your brother, and against the son of your mother you placed a stumbling block.
verses.49:21: These things you have done, and I kept silent. You have wickedly supposed that I will be like you: I will reprove you, and I will set them before your face.
verses.49:22: Understand these things, you who forget God; otherwise He may snatch you away at any time, and there will be no one to rescue.
verses.49:23: A sacrifice of praise will honor Me, and there is the way by which I will show him the salvation of God."
verses.50:1: To the end. A psalm of David,
verses.50:2: when the prophet Nathan came to him, when he had gone in to Bathsheba.
verses.50:3: Have mercy on me, God, according to Your great mercy; and according to the abundance of Your compassions, erase my iniquity.
verses.50:4: Wash me more fully from my iniquity, and from my sin cleanse me.
verses.50:5: For I myself acknowledge my iniquity, and my sin is always against me.
verses.50:6: Against You alone I have sinned, and have done evil in Your presence, so that You may be justified in Your words and prevail when You are judged.
verses.50:7: For look, in iniquities I was conceived, and in sins my mother conceived me.
verses.50:8: For look, You have loved truth; You have made known to me the uncertain and hidden things of Your wisdom.
verses.50:9: You will sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be cleansed; You will wash me, and I will become whiter than snow.
verses.50:10: To my hearing You will give joy and gladness, and the humbled bones will exult.
verses.50:11: Turn Your face away from my sins, and erase all my iniquities.
verses.50:12: Create a clean heart in me, God, and renew an upright spirit in my inward parts.
verses.50:13: Do not cast me out from Your face, and do not take away Your Holy Spirit from me.
verses.50:14: Restore to me the gladness of Your salvation, and strengthen me with a sovereign spirit.
verses.50:15: I will teach the unjust Your ways, and the ungodly will turn back to You.
verses.50:16: Deliver me from bloodshed, God, God of my salvation, and my tongue will exult in Your righteousness.
verses.50:17: Lord, You will open my lips, and my mouth will proclaim Your praise.
verses.50:18: For if You had desired sacrifice, I would certainly have given it; You will not take pleasure in burnt offerings.
verses.50:19: A sacrifice to God is a crushed spirit; a contrite and humbled heart, God, You will not despise.
verses.50:20: Deal kindly with Zion, Lord, in Your goodwill, so that the walls of Jerusalem may be built.
verses.50:21: Then You will accept a sacrifice of righteousness, offerings and burnt offerings; then they will place calves on Your altar.
verses.51:1: To the end. Understanding of David,
verses.51:2: when Doeg the Edomite came and reported to Saul, "David has come into the house of Ahimelech."
verses.51:3: Why do you boast in malice, you who are mighty in iniquity?
verses.51:4: All day long your tongue has devised unrighteousness; like a sharp razor, you have practiced deceit.
verses.51:5: You have loved malice above kindness; iniquity rather than speaking uprightness.
verses.51:6: You have loved all words of downfall, deceitful tongue.
verses.51:7: Therefore God will destroy you to the end; He will tear you out and remove you from your tent, and your root from the land of the living.
verses.51:8: The righteous will see and fear; and they will laugh over him and say:
verses.51:9: "Here is the man who did not make God his helper, but hoped in the abundance of his riches and grew strong in his vanity."
verses.51:10: But I am like a fruitful olive tree in the house of God; I have hoped in the mercy of God forever and for age upon age.
verses.51:11: I will give thanks to You forever, because You have acted; and I will wait for Your name, for it is good in the sight of Your holy ones.
verses.52:1: To the end, for Mahalath; of the understanding of David. The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God."
verses.52:2: They are corrupt and have become abominable in iniquities; there is no one who does good.
verses.52:3: God has looked down from heaven on the sons of men, so that He may see whether there is one who understands, or one who seeks God.
verses.52:4: All have turned aside; together they have become useless; there is no one who does good, there is not even one.
verses.52:5: Will they not know, all who work iniquity, who devour My people like a meal of bread?
verses.52:6: They did not call on God; there they trembled with fear, where there was no fear. For God scattered the bones of those who please men; they were put to shame, because God spurned them.
verses.52:7: Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When God turns back the captivity of His people, Jacob will exult, and Israel will be glad.
verses.53:1: To the end, with songs. Understanding of David,
verses.53:2: when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, "Is David not hidden with us?"
verses.53:3: God, save me in Your name, and judge me in Your power.
verses.53:4: God, hear my prayer; receive with Your ears the words of my mouth.
verses.53:5: Because strangers have risen up against me, and strong men have sought my soul, and they have not placed God before their sight.
verses.53:6: For look, God helps me, and the Lord is the upholder of my soul.
verses.53:7: Turn back evils upon my enemies, and in Your truth destroy them.
verses.53:8: I will sacrifice to You willingly, and I will offer praise to Your name, Lord, because it is good.
verses.53:9: For You have rescued me out of every affliction, and my eye has looked down on my enemies.
verses.54:1: To the end, with songs. Understanding of David.
verses.54:2: Hear my prayer, God, and do not disregard my supplication;
verses.54:3: pay attention to me and hear me. I have been saddened in my exercise, and I have been disturbed
verses.54:4: by the voice of the enemy and by the affliction of the sinner. For they have turned iniquities upon me, and in anger they were grievous to me.
verses.54:5: My heart is disturbed within me, and the dread of death has fallen on me.
verses.54:6: Fear and trembling have come upon me, and darkness has covered me over.
verses.54:7: And I said, "Who will give me wings like those of a dove, and I will fly, and I will rest?"
verses.54:8: Look, I went far away, fleeing, and remained in the wilderness.
verses.54:9: I was waiting for Him who saved me from faintheartedness of spirit and storm.
verses.54:10: Cast them down, Lord; divide their tongues, for I have seen iniquity and dispute in the city.
verses.54:11: Day and night iniquity will surround it on its walls, and toil is in its midst,
verses.54:12: and injustice; and usury and deceit have not ceased from its squares.
verses.54:13: For if my enemy had cursed me, I would certainly have endured it. And if the one who hated me had spoken great things over me, perhaps I would have hidden myself from him.
verses.54:14: But you, a like-minded man, my guide and my acquaintance,
verses.54:15: who together with me used to take sweet foods; in the house of God we walked in agreement.
verses.54:16: Let death come upon them, and let them descend into hell alive, for wicked deeds are in their dwellings, in their midst.
verses.54:17: As for me, I cried out to God, and the Lord will save me.
verses.54:18: At evening, and in the morning, and at noon, I will recount and declare, and He will hear my voice.
verses.54:19: He will redeem my soul in peace from those who draw near to me, for among many they were with me.
verses.54:20: God will hear and humble them, He who is before the ages. For there is no change for them, and they have not feared God.
verses.54:21: He has stretched out His hand in repaying; they have defiled His covenant;
verses.54:22: they were divided by the anger of His face, and that one's heart drew near; his words were made softer than oil, yet they themselves are darts.
verses.54:23: Cast your concern on the Lord, and He Himself will nourish you; He will never give wavering to the righteous one.
verses.54:24: But You, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Men of blood and deceitful men will not reach half their days; but I will hope in You, Lord.
verses.55:1: To the end, for the people who were removed far from the holy things. Of David, for a title inscription, when the foreigners held him in Gath.
verses.55:2: Be merciful to me, God, for man has trampled on me; attacking all day long, he has afflicted me.
verses.55:3: My enemies have trampled on me all day long, for many are waging war against me.
verses.55:4: From the height of the day I will fear, but I will hope in You.
verses.55:5: In God I will praise my words; in God I have hoped; I will not fear what flesh may do to me.
verses.55:6: All day long they detested my words; all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.55:7: They will dwell and hide; they themselves will watch my heel. Just as they have waited for my soul,
verses.55:8: for nothing You will save them; in anger You will shatter the peoples.
verses.55:9: God, I have declared my life to You; You have set my tears in Your sight, just as also in Your promise;
verses.55:10: then my enemies will be turned back. On whatever day I call upon You, look, I know that You are my God.
verses.55:11: In God I will praise the word; in the Lord I will praise the saying. In God I have hoped; I will not fear what man may do to me.
verses.55:13: In me, God, are Your vows, which I will pay, praises to You;
verses.55:14: for You have rescued my soul from death and my feet from slipping, so that I may be pleasing before God in the light of the living.
verses.56:1: To the end, do not destroy. Of David, for the inscription of a title, when he fled from the face of Saul into the cave.
verses.56:2: Have mercy on me, God, have mercy on me, for my soul trusts in You. And in the shadow of Your wings I will hope, until iniquity passes by.
verses.56:3: I will cry out to God Most High, God who has done good to me.
verses.56:4: He sent from heaven and delivered me; He gave over to reproach those who trample me. God sent His mercy and His truth,
verses.56:5: and rescued my soul from the midst of lion cubs. I slept troubled. The sons of men: their teeth are weapons and arrows, and their tongue is a sharp sword.
verses.56:6: Be exalted above the heavens, God, and may Your glory be throughout all the earth.
verses.56:7: They prepared a snare for my feet, and bowed down my soul. They dug a pit before my face, and fell into it.
verses.56:8: My heart is prepared, God, my heart is prepared; I will sing and recite a psalm.
verses.56:9: Arise, my glory; arise, psaltery and lyre; I will arise at dawn.
verses.56:10: I will praise You among the peoples, Lord, and I will recite a psalm to You among the nations,
verses.56:11: for Your mercy has been magnified even to the heavens, and Your truth even to the clouds.
verses.56:12: Be exalted above the heavens, God, and may Your glory be above all the earth.
verses.57:1: To the end, do not destroy. Of David, for the inscription of a title.
verses.57:2: If indeed you truly speak justice, judge what is right, sons of men.
verses.57:3: For indeed in your heart you work iniquities; on the earth your hands contrive injustices.
verses.57:4: Sinners have been estranged from the womb; they have gone astray from the belly; they have spoken falsehoods.
verses.57:5: Their fury is according to the likeness of a serpent, like that of a deaf asp stopping up its ears,
verses.57:6: which will not hear the voice of charmers and of the sorcerer charming wisely.
verses.57:7: God will crush their teeth in their own mouth; the Lord will shatter the grinding teeth of the lions.
verses.57:8: They will come to nothing like water flowing away; He bends His bow until they are weakened.
verses.57:9: Like wax that melts, they will be taken away; fire has fallen upon them, and they have not seen the sun.
verses.57:10: Before your thorns could understand the bramble, as though alive, so in wrath He swallows them up.
verses.57:11: The righteous one will rejoice when he sees vengeance; he will wash his hands in the blood of the sinner.
verses.57:12: And man will say, "If indeed there is fruit for the righteous one, indeed there is a God judging them on the earth."
verses.58:1: To the end, do not destroy. Of David, for the inscription of a title, when Saul sent and watched his house to kill him.
verses.58:2: Rescue me from my enemies, my God, and from those rising up against me deliver me.
verses.58:3: Rescue me from those working iniquity, and from men of blood save me.
verses.58:4: Because look, they have captured my soul; the strong have rushed upon me.
verses.58:5: It is neither my iniquity nor my sin, Lord; without iniquity I ran and went straight.
verses.58:6: Arise to meet me, and see; and You, Lord God of hosts, God of Israel, attend to visiting all the nations; do not have mercy on all who work iniquity.
verses.58:7: They will return at evening, and suffer hunger like dogs, and go around the city.
verses.58:8: Look, they will speak with their mouth, and a sword is on their lips: "For who has heard?"
verses.58:9: And You, Lord, will deride them; You will bring all the nations to nothing.
verses.58:10: My strength I will keep for You, because, God, You are my upholder:
verses.58:11: My God, His mercy will go before me.
verses.58:12: God will let me look upon my enemies; do not kill them, so that they may never forget my people. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, my protector, Lord:
verses.58:13: the offense of their mouth, the word of their own lips; and let them be caught in their pride. And for cursing and lying they will be declared
verses.58:14: in consummation, in the wrath of consummation, and they will not be. And they will know that God will rule over Jacob and the ends of the earth.
verses.58:15: They will return at evening, and suffer hunger like dogs, and go around the city.
verses.58:16: They themselves will be scattered to eat; but if they are not satisfied, they will also murmur.
verses.58:17: But I will sing of Your strength, and in the morning I will exult in Your mercy, because You have become my upholder and my refuge in the day of my tribulation.
verses.58:18: My helper, to You I will sing psalms, because You, God, are my upholder; my God, my mercy.
verses.59:1: To the end, for those who will be changed, as a title inscription, for David himself, for instruction,
verses.59:2: when he set fire to Mesopotamia of Syria and Sobal, and Joab turned back, and struck down Idumea in the Valley of the Salt Pits, twelve thousand.
verses.59:3: God, You have rejected us and torn us down; You have been angry, and You have had mercy on us.
verses.59:4: You have shaken the earth and thrown it into turmoil; heal its fractures, for it has been shaken.
verses.59:5: You have shown Your people harsh things; You have given us wine of compunction to drink.
verses.59:6: You have given a signal to those who fear You, so that they may flee from the face of the bow, so that Your beloved ones may be delivered.
verses.59:7: Save by Your right hand, and hear me.
verses.59:8: God has spoken in His sanctuary: "I will rejoice and apportion Shechem, and I will measure out the valley of tents.
verses.59:9: Mine is Gilead, and Mine is Manasseh; and Ephraim is the strength of My head. Judah is My king;
verses.59:10: Moab is the pot of My hope. Into Idumea I will stretch out My sandal; to Me foreigners have been subjected."
verses.59:11: Who will lead me into the fortified city? Who will lead me all the way into Idumea?
verses.59:12: Is it not You, God, who have rejected us? And will You not go out, God, with our forces?
verses.59:13: Give us help from affliction, for the deliverance of man is vain.
verses.59:14: In God we will show strength, and He Himself will reduce to nothing those who afflict us.
verses.60:1: To the end. In hymns of David.
verses.60:2: Hear, God, my supplication; attend to my prayer.
verses.60:3: From the ends of the earth I cried out to You while my heart was in distress; on a rock You lifted me up. You led me,
verses.60:4: for You have become my hope: a tower of strength from the face of the enemy.
verses.60:5: I will dwell in Your tent for all ages; I will be sheltered in the covering of Your wings.
verses.60:6: For You, my God, have heard my prayer; You have given a heritage to those who fear Your name.
verses.60:7: You will add days upon the days of the king, his years all the way to the day of generation and generation.
verses.60:8: He remains forever in the sight of God; who will seek out His mercy and truth?
verses.60:9: Thus I will sing a psalm to Your name forever and ever, so that I may fulfill my vows day by day.
verses.61:1: To the end, for Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
verses.61:2: Will my soul not be subject to God? For from Him comes my salvation.
verses.61:3: For indeed He is my God and my Savior, my upholder; I will not be moved any longer.
verses.61:4: How long do you rush upon a man? All of you kill, as against a leaning wall and a pushed-down stone fence.
verses.61:5: Nevertheless, they planned to reject my worth; I ran in thirst; with their mouth they were blessing, and in their heart they were cursing.
verses.61:6: Nevertheless, be subject to God, my soul, because from Him comes my patience;
verses.61:7: for He Himself is my God and my Savior, my helper; I will not depart.
verses.61:8: My salvation and my glory are in God; He is the God of my help, and my hope is in God.
verses.61:9: Hope in Him, all the assembly of the people; pour out your hearts before Him: God is our helper forever.
verses.61:10: Nevertheless, the sons of men are vain, the sons of men are false in the scales, so that they themselves may deceive out of vanity together.
verses.61:11: Do not hope in iniquity, and do not covet plunder; if wealth abounds, do not set your heart on it.
verses.61:12: Once God has spoken; these two things I have heard: that power belongs to God,
verses.61:13: and to You, Lord, belongs mercy, for You will repay each one according to his works.
verses.62:1: A psalm of David, when he was in the desert of Idumea.
verses.62:2: God, my God, I keep watch for You from daybreak. My soul has thirsted for You; in how many ways my flesh has thirsted for You!
verses.62:3: In a desert land, both pathless and waterless, thus in the sanctuary I appeared before You, so that I might see Your power and Your glory.
verses.62:4: Because Your mercy is better than lives, my lips will praise You.
verses.62:5: So I will bless You in my life, and in Your name I will raise my hands.
verses.62:6: May my soul be filled as with fat and richness, and with lips of exultation my mouth will praise.
verses.62:7: If I have been mindful of You on my bed, in the morning hours I will meditate on You.
verses.62:8: For You have been my helper, and in the covering of Your wings I will exult.
verses.62:9: My soul has clung after You; Your right hand has upheld me.
verses.62:10: But they themselves have sought my soul in vain; they will enter into the lower parts of the earth;
verses.62:11: they will be handed over into the hands of the sword; they will be portions for foxes.
verses.62:12: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will be praised, because the mouth of those who speak unjust things has been stopped up.
verses.63:1: For the end. A psalm of David.
verses.63:2: Hear my prayer, God, when I plead; rescue my soul from fear of the enemy.
verses.63:3: You have sheltered me from the gathering of evildoers, from the multitude of those who work iniquity.
verses.63:4: For they have sharpened their tongues like a sword; they have bent a bow, a bitter thing,
verses.63:5: so that in hidden places they may shoot the blameless one.
verses.63:6: Suddenly they will shoot him, and they will not fear; they have confirmed for themselves a wicked word. They talked of hiding snares; they said, "Who will see them?"
verses.63:7: They have searched out iniquities; they have failed while searching with a search. A man will approach a deep heart,
verses.63:8: and God will be exalted. The arrows of little children have become their wounds,
verses.63:9: and their tongues have been weakened against them. All who saw them were thrown into turmoil,
verses.63:10: and every man feared. And they declared the works of God, and understood His deeds.
verses.63:11: The righteous one will rejoice in the Lord, and will hope in Him, and all the upright in heart will be praised.
verses.64:1: For the end. A psalm of David, a song of Jeremiah and Ezekiel for the people of the exile, when they were beginning to go out.
verses.64:2: A hymn befits You, God, in Zion, and a vow will be paid to You in Jerusalem.
verses.64:3: Hear my prayer; to You all flesh will come.
verses.64:4: The words of the unjust have prevailed over us, and You Yourself will pardon our impieties.
verses.64:5: Blessed is the one whom You have chosen and received; he will dwell in Your courts. We will be filled with the good things of Your house; Your temple is holy,
verses.64:6: marvelous in equity. Hear us, God, our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth, and on the sea far off,
verses.64:7: preparing the mountains in Your power, girded with might;
verses.64:8: who stir up the depth of the sea, the sound of its waves. The nations will be thrown into turmoil,
verses.64:9: and those who inhabit the boundaries will fear at Your signs; You will delight the outgoings of morning and evening.
verses.64:10: You have visited the earth and drenched it; You have enriched it many times over. The river of God is filled with waters; You have prepared their food, for such is its preparation.
verses.64:11: Drench its streams; multiply its produce; in its raindrops it will rejoice as it sprouts.
verses.64:12: You will bless the crown of the year of Your kindness, and Your fields will be filled with abundance.
verses.64:13: The beautiful places of the desert will grow rich, and the hills will be girded with exultation.
verses.64:14: The rams of the sheep are clothed, and the valleys will abound with grain; they will shout; indeed, they will sing a hymn.
verses.65:1: For the end. A song of a psalm of the resurrection. Shout joyfully to God, all the earth;
verses.65:2: sing a psalm to His name; give glory to His praise.
verses.65:3: Say to God, "How fearsome are Your works, Lord! In the abundance of Your power Your enemies will lie to You.
verses.65:4: May all the earth worship You and sing praises to You; may it sing a psalm to Your name."
verses.65:5: Come and see the works of God: He is fearsome in counsels over the sons of men.
verses.65:6: He who turns the sea into dry land; they will pass through the river on foot; there we will rejoice in Him.
verses.65:7: He who rules in His power forever; His eyes look over the nations; let those who provoke not be exalted in themselves.
verses.65:8: Bless our God, nations, and make the voice of His praise heard,
verses.65:9: who set my soul to life and did not give my feet over to shaking.
verses.65:10: For You tested us, God; You tried us with fire, just as silver is tried.
verses.65:11: You brought us into a snare; You laid tribulations on our back;
verses.65:12: You placed men over our heads. We passed through fire and water, and You brought us out into refreshment.
verses.65:13: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will pay You my vows
verses.65:14: which my lips pronounced and my mouth spoke in my tribulation.
verses.65:15: I will offer You burnt offerings full of marrow, with the incense of rams; I will offer You oxen with male goats.
verses.65:16: Come, listen, and I will tell, all you who fear God, what great things He has done for my soul.
verses.65:17: To Him I cried out with my mouth, and I exalted Him under my tongue.
verses.65:18: If I have looked upon iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear.
verses.65:19: Therefore God has heard, and has attended to the voice of my supplication.
verses.65:20: Blessed be God, who has not removed my prayer or His mercy from me.
verses.66:1: For the end, in hymns. A psalm of a song of David.
verses.66:2: May God have mercy on us and bless us; may He make His face shine upon us and have mercy on us,
verses.66:3: so that we may know Your way on the earth, Your salvation among all nations.
verses.66:4: May the peoples give thanks to You, God; may all the peoples give thanks to You.
verses.66:5: May the nations rejoice and exult, for You judge the peoples in equity and direct the nations on the earth.
verses.66:6: May the peoples give thanks to You, God; may all the peoples give thanks to You.
verses.66:7: The earth has given its fruit: may God, our God, bless us!
verses.66:8: May God bless us, and may all the ends of the earth fear Him.
verses.67:1: For the end. A psalm of a song for David himself.
verses.67:2: May God rise up, and may His enemies be scattered, and may those who hate Him flee from His face.
verses.67:3: As smoke vanishes, may they vanish; as wax melts before the face of fire, so may sinners perish before the face of God.
verses.67:4: And may the righteous feast, and exult in the sight of God, and delight in gladness.
verses.67:5: Sing to God; sing a psalm to His name; make a way for Him who ascends above the west. The Lord is His name; exult in His sight. They will be troubled before the face of Him,
verses.67:6: the father of orphans and the judge of widows; God is in His holy place.
verses.67:7: God, who makes those of one mind dwell in a house; who brings out prisoners in strength, likewise those who provoke, who dwell in tombs.
verses.67:8: God, when You went forth in the sight of Your people, when You passed through the desert,
verses.67:9: the earth was shaken, indeed the heavens dripped, before the face of the God of Sinai, before the face of the God of Israel.
verses.67:10: You will set apart a freewill rain, God, for Your inheritance; and it grew weak, yet You perfected it.
verses.67:11: Your living creatures will dwell in it; You prepared in Your sweetness for the poor, God.
verses.67:12: The Lord will give the word to those who proclaim good news, with great power.
verses.67:13: The King of hosts belongs to the beloved, to the beloved; and it is for the beauty of the house to divide the spoils.
verses.67:14: If you sleep in the midst of the lots, the wings of a dove are overlaid with silver, and the rear parts of its back are in the paleness of gold.
verses.67:15: While the Heavenly One distinguishes kings over it, they will be made white with snow in Zalmon.
verses.67:16: A mountain of God, a fat mountain; a curdled mountain, a fat mountain.
verses.67:17: Why do you suspect curdled mountains? This is a mountain in which God has been well pleased to dwell; for indeed the Lord will dwell to the end.
verses.67:18: The chariot of God is multiplied by ten thousands, thousands of those who rejoice; the Lord is among them in Sinai, in the holy place.
verses.67:19: You ascended on high, You captured captivity, You received gifts among men; indeed, even those who do not believe, so that the Lord God may dwell.
verses.67:20: Blessed be the Lord day by day; the God of our salvations will make a prosperous journey for us.
verses.67:21: Our God is the God of saving, and to the Lord, the Lord belong the ways out of death.
verses.67:22: Nevertheless, God will shatter the heads of His enemies, the crown of hair of those who walk about in their offenses.
verses.67:23: The Lord said, "From Bashan I will turn back, I will turn back into the depth of the sea,
verses.67:24: so that your foot may be dipped in blood; the tongue of your dogs from the enemies, from him."
verses.67:25: They have seen Your entrances, God, the entrances of my God, my King, who is in the holy place.
verses.67:26: Princes went ahead, joined with those who sing praises, in the midst of young women playing tambourines.
verses.67:27: In the assemblies bless God the Lord from the fountains of Israel.
verses.67:28: There is Benjamin, a youth, in ecstasy of mind; the princes of Judah, their leaders; the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
verses.67:29: Command Your power, God; confirm this, God, which You have worked in us.
verses.67:30: From Your temple in Jerusalem, kings will offer gifts to You.
verses.67:31: Rebuke the wild beasts of the reed, the gathering of bulls among the cows of the peoples, so that they may shut out those who have been tested with silver. Scatter the nations that desire wars.
verses.67:32: Envoys will come from Egypt; Ethiopia will hasten her hands to God.
verses.67:33: Kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; sing praises to the Lord; sing praises to God.
verses.67:34: He who ascends above the heaven of heaven, toward the east: look, He will give to His voice a voice of power.
verses.67:35: Give glory to God over Israel; His magnificence and His power are in the clouds.
verses.67:36: God is wondrous in His saints; the God of Israel Himself will give power and strength to His people. Blessed be God!
verses.68:1: To the end, for those who will be changed. Of David.
verses.68:2: Save me, God, for the waters have entered even to my soul.
verses.68:3: I am stuck fast in the mire of the deep, and there is no standing ground. I have come into the depth of the sea, and a storm has submerged me.
verses.68:4: I have grown weary crying out, my throat has become hoarse; my eyes have failed while I hope in my God.
verses.68:5: Those who hate me without cause have multiplied beyond the hairs of my head. My enemies who have persecuted me unjustly have grown strong; what I did not seize, then I was paying back.
verses.68:6: God, You know my foolishness, and my offenses are not hidden from You.
verses.68:7: May those who wait for You not be ashamed because of me, Lord, Lord of hosts; may those who seek You not be put to shame over me, God of Israel.
verses.68:8: For on account of You I have endured reproach; shame has covered my face.
verses.68:9: I have become an outsider to my brothers, and a foreigner to the sons of my mother.
verses.68:10: Because zeal for Your house has devoured me, and the reproaches of those who cast reproach on You have fallen upon me.
verses.68:11: And I covered my soul in fasting, and it became a reproach to me.
verses.68:12: And I made my garment sackcloth, and I became a proverb to them.
verses.68:13: Those who sat in the gate were speaking against me, and those who drank wine were singing songs against me.
verses.68:14: But as for me, my prayer is to You, Lord; a time of good pleasure, God. In the multitude of Your mercy, hear me in the truth of Your salvation.
verses.68:15: Rescue me from the mud, so that I may not be stuck fast; deliver me from those who hate me, and from the depths of the waters.
verses.68:16: May the storm of water not submerge me, nor may the deep swallow me up, nor may the pit press its mouth over me.
verses.68:17: Hear me, Lord, for Your mercy is kind; according to the multitude of Your compassions, look upon me.
verses.68:18: And do not turn Your face away from Your servant; because I am afflicted, hear me quickly.
verses.68:19: Attend to my soul and deliver it; because of my enemies, rescue me.
verses.68:20: You know my reproach, and my shame, and my humiliation;
verses.68:21: in Your sight are all who afflict me. My heart expected reproach and misery; and I waited for someone who would grieve together with me, and there was no one, and for someone who would comfort me, and I found no one.
verses.68:22: And they gave gall as my food, and in my thirst they made me drink vinegar.
verses.68:23: May their table before them turn into a snare, and into retributions, and into a stumbling block.
verses.68:24: May their eyes be darkened so that they may not see, and bend their back down always.
verses.68:25: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and may the fury of Your wrath seize them.
verses.68:26: May their dwelling become desolate, and in their tents may there be no one who dwells.
verses.68:27: For they have persecuted the one whom You struck, and they have added to the pain of my wounds.
verses.68:28: Add iniquity upon their iniquity, and may they not enter into Your righteousness.
verses.68:29: May they be erased from the book of the living, and may they not be written down with the righteous.
verses.68:30: I am poor and in pain; Your salvation, God, has upheld me.
verses.68:31: I will praise the name of God with a song, and I will magnify Him in praise;
verses.68:32: and it will please God more than a young bull bringing forth horns and hooves.
verses.68:33: May the poor see and be glad; seek God, and your soul will live;
verses.68:34: for the Lord has heard the poor and has not despised His prisoners.
verses.68:35: May the heavens and the earth praise Him, the sea, and all creeping creatures in them.
verses.68:36: For God will save Zion, and the cities of Judah will be built, and they will dwell there and acquire it by inheritance.
verses.68:37: And the offspring of His servants will possess it, and those who love His name will dwell in it.
verses.69:1: To the end. A psalm of David for remembrance, that the Lord saved him.
verses.69:2: God, attend to my help; Lord, hurry to help me.
verses.69:3: May those who seek my soul be put to shame and humiliated.
verses.69:4: May those who wish evil for me be turned backward and be ashamed; may those who say to me, "Aha, aha!" be turned away immediately, blushing with shame.
verses.69:5: May all who seek You exult and be glad in You; and may those who love Your salvation always say, "May the Lord be magnified."
verses.69:6: But I am needy and poor; God, help me. You are my helper and my deliverer; Lord, do not delay.
verses.70:1: A psalm of David, of the sons of Jonadab, and of the first captives. In You, Lord, I have hoped; may I not be put to shame forever.
verses.70:2: In Your righteousness deliver me and rescue me; incline Your ear to me and save me.
verses.70:3: Be to me a protecting God and a fortified place, so that You may save me; for You are my stronghold and my refuge.
verses.70:4: My God, rescue me from the hand of the sinner, and from the hand of the one acting against the law and of the unjust;
verses.70:5: for You are my patience, Lord; Lord, my hope from my youth.
verses.70:6: In You I have been strengthened from the womb; from the belly of my mother You are my protector; in You is my song always.
verses.70:7: I have become like a portent to many, and You are a strong helper.
verses.70:8: May my mouth be filled with praise, so that I may sing Your glory, all day long Your greatness.
verses.70:9: Do not cast me away in the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not abandon me.
verses.70:10: For my enemies have spoken about me, and those who were watching my soul took counsel together,
verses.70:11: saying, "God has abandoned him; pursue and seize him, because there is no one to rescue him."
verses.70:12: God, do not keep far from me; my God, look to my help.
verses.70:13: May those who slander my soul be put to shame and fail; may those who seek evil for me be covered with shame and dishonor.
verses.70:14: But I will always hope, and I will add to all Your praise.
verses.70:15: My mouth will declare Your righteousness, all day long Your salvation. Since I have not known learning,
verses.70:16: I will enter into the powers of the Lord; Lord, I will remember Your righteousness alone.
verses.70:17: God, You have taught me from my youth, and up to now I will proclaim Your wonders.
verses.70:18: And even into old age and advanced age, God, do not abandon me, until I declare Your arm to every generation that is to come, Your power,
verses.70:19: and Your righteousness, God, even to the highest heights; the great things that You have done, God: who is like You?
verses.70:20: What great afflictions, many and evil, You have shown me! And turning back, You have given me life, and from the abysses of the earth You have brought me back again.
verses.70:21: You have multiplied Your magnificence, and turning back, You have comforted me.
verses.70:22: For I also will acknowledge Your truth to You with instruments of the psalm, God; I will sing praise to You on the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
verses.70:23: My lips will exult when I sing to You, and my soul, which You have redeemed.
verses.70:24: Moreover, my tongue also will meditate on Your righteousness all day long, when those who seek evil for me have been put to shame and humiliated.
verses.71:2: God, give Your judgment to the king, and Your righteousness to the son of the king, to judge Your people in righteousness, and Your poor in judgment.
verses.71:3: May the mountains receive peace for the people, and the hills righteousness.
verses.71:4: He will judge the poor of the people, and he will save the children of the poor, and he will bring low the false accuser.
verses.71:5: And he will endure with the sun, and before the moon, through generation and generation.
verses.71:6: He will come down like rain upon a fleece, and like droplets dripping upon the earth.
verses.71:7: In his days righteousness will arise, and an abundance of peace, until the moon is taken away.
verses.71:8: And he will rule from sea to sea, and from the river to the boundaries of the world.
verses.71:9: Before him the Ethiopians will fall down, and his enemies will lick the earth.
verses.71:10: The kings of Tarshish and the islands will offer gifts; the kings of the Arabs and of Sheba will bring presents;
verses.71:11: and all the kings of the earth will adore him; all nations will serve him.
verses.71:12: For he will deliver the poor man from the mighty, and the poor man who had no helper.
verses.71:13: He will spare the poor and the needy, and he will save the souls of the poor.
verses.71:14: From usury and iniquity he will redeem their souls, and their name is honorable before him.
verses.71:15: And he will live, and some of the gold of Arabia will be given to him; and they will pray concerning him always, all day long they will bless him.
verses.71:16: And there will be a support in the earth on the tops of the mountains; its fruit will be exalted above Lebanon, and they will flourish from the city like the grass of the earth.
verses.71:17: May his name be blessed forever; before the sun his name endures. And in him all the tribes of the earth will be blessed; all nations will magnify him.
verses.71:18: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who alone does marvelous things.
verses.71:19: And blessed be the name of His majesty forever, and all the earth will be filled with His majesty. So be it, so be it.
verses.71:20: The praises of David, the son of Jesse, have come to an end.
verses.72:1: A psalm of Asaph. How good God is to Israel, to those who are upright in heart!
verses.72:2: But my feet were nearly moved, my steps were nearly poured out,
verses.72:3: because I was envious of the unrighteous, seeing the peace of sinners.
verses.72:4: For there is no regard for their death, and there is firmness in their affliction.
verses.72:5: They are not in the toil of men, and with men they will not be scourged.
verses.72:6: Therefore pride has taken hold of them; they are covered with their iniquity and ungodliness.
verses.72:7: Their iniquity has come forth as if from fatness; they have gone over into the desire of the heart.
verses.72:8: They have thought and spoken wickedness; they have spoken iniquity on high.
verses.72:9: They have set their mouth against heaven, and their tongue has passed over the earth.
verses.72:10: Therefore my people will turn here, and full days will be found in them.
verses.72:11: And they said, "How does God know, and is there knowledge in the Most High?"
verses.72:12: Look, these are sinners, and abounding in the world, they have obtained riches.
verses.72:13: And I said, "Therefore without cause I have justified my heart, and washed my hands among the innocent,
verses.72:14: and I have been scourged all day long, and my chastisement has been in the mornings."
verses.72:15: If I said, "I will speak like this," look, I condemned the race of Your children.
verses.72:16: I pondered in order to know this; it is a toil before me,
verses.72:17: until I enter into the sanctuary of God, and understand their final end.
verses.72:18: Nevertheless, because of deceits You have set it for them; You cast them down while they were being lifted up.
verses.72:19: How have they been made into a desolation? Suddenly they have failed; they have perished because of their iniquity.
verses.72:20: Like the dream of those who rise, Lord, in Your city You will bring their image to nothing.
verses.72:21: For my heart was inflamed, and my kidneys were changed;
verses.72:22: and I was brought to nothing, and I did not know; I became like a beast before You, and I am always with You.
verses.72:24: You have held my right hand, and in Your will You have led me, and with glory You have received me.
verses.72:25: For what do I have in heaven? And apart from You, what have I desired upon the earth?
verses.72:26: My flesh and my heart have failed; God of my heart, and my portion, God forever.
verses.72:27: For look, those who distance themselves from You will perish; You have destroyed all who commit fornication apart from You.
verses.72:28: But for me it is good to cling to God, to place my hope in the Lord God, so that I may declare all Your praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
verses.73:1: Understanding of Asaph. Why, God, have You cast us off to the end; has Your fury grown angry against the sheep of Your pasture?
verses.73:2: Remember Your congregation, which You have possessed from the beginning. You redeemed the rod of Your inheritance, Mount Zion, in which You dwelt.
verses.73:3: Lift up Your hands against their acts of pride to the end; how much evil the enemy has done in the holy place!
verses.73:4: And those who hate You have boasted in the midst of Your solemn feast; they have set up their signs as signs,
verses.73:5: and they did not know, as in the exit above the highest point. As in a forest of trees, with axes
verses.73:6: they cut down its doors all at once; with axe and hatchet they cast it down.
verses.73:7: They have burned Your sanctuary with fire; on the ground they have defiled the tabernacle of Your name.
verses.73:8: Their kindred said together in their heart, "Let us make all the feast days of God cease from the earth."
verses.73:9: We have not seen our signs; there is no longer a prophet, and he will know us no more.
verses.73:10: How long, God, will the enemy reproach? Does the adversary provoke Your name to the end?
verses.73:11: Why do You turn away Your hand, and Your right hand from the midst of Your bosom to the end?
verses.73:12: Yet God is our King before the ages; He has worked salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.73:13: You strengthened the sea in Your power; You crushed the heads of the dragons in the waters.
verses.73:14: You shattered the heads of the dragon; You gave him as food to the peoples of the Ethiopians.
verses.73:15: You broke open springs and torrents; You dried up the rivers of Ethan.
verses.73:16: Yours is the day, and Yours is the night; You fashioned the dawn and the sun.
verses.73:17: You made all the boundaries of the earth; summer and spring, You formed them.
verses.73:18: Remember this: the enemy has reproached the Lord, and a foolish people has provoked Your name.
verses.73:19: Do not hand over to the beasts the souls confessing to You, and do not forget the souls of Your poor to the end.
verses.73:20: Look upon Your covenant, for those of the earth who have been darkened have been filled with houses of iniquities.
verses.73:21: May the humble not be turned away, brought to shame; the poor and the needy will praise Your name.
verses.73:22: Rise up, God, judge Your cause; remember Your reproaches, those that come from the fool all day long.
verses.73:23: Do not forget the voices of Your enemies; the pride of those who hate You ascends always.
verses.74:1: To the end, do not destroy. A psalm of a song of Asaph.
verses.74:2: We will give thanks to You, God, we will give thanks, and we will call upon Your name; we will recount Your wonders.
verses.74:3: When I have received the time, I will judge with righteousness.
verses.74:4: The earth has melted, and all who dwell in it; I have made firm its pillars.
verses.74:5: I said to the wicked, "Do not act wickedly," and to those who transgress, "Do not lift up the horn;
verses.74:6: do not raise your horn on high; do not speak wickedness against God."
verses.74:7: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the desert mountains;
verses.74:8: because God is judge. One He humbles, and another He lifts up;
verses.74:9: for in the hand of the Lord is a cup of pure wine, full of mixture. And He has poured from this into that; yet its dregs have not been emptied: all the sinners of the earth will drink.
verses.74:10: But I will declare forever; I will sing to the God of Jacob,
verses.74:11: and I will shatter all the horns of sinners, and the horns of the righteous one will be lifted up.
verses.75:1: To the end, in praises. A psalm of Asaph, a song concerning the Assyrians.
verses.75:2: God is known in Judea; in Israel His name is great.
verses.75:3: And His place has been made in peace, and His dwelling in Zion.
verses.75:4: There He shattered the powers of the bows, shield, sword, and war.
verses.75:5: You give light wondrously from the eternal mountains;
verses.75:6: all the foolish in heart were troubled. They slept their sleep, and all the men of riches found nothing in their hands.
verses.75:7: At Your rebuke, God of Jacob, those who mounted horses slumbered.
verses.75:8: You are fearsome; and who will resist You? From then is Your wrath.
verses.75:9: From heaven You made judgment heard; the earth trembled and became still
verses.75:10: when God rose up for judgment, to save all the meek of the earth.
verses.75:11: For the thought of man will give thanks to You, and the remnant of thought will keep a feast day to You.
verses.75:12: Vow and pay to the Lord your God, all you around Him who bring gifts to the Fearsome One,
verses.75:13: and to Him who takes away the spirit of princes, fearsome among the kings of the earth.
verses.76:1: To the end, for Jeduthun. A psalm of Asaph.
verses.76:2: With my voice I cried out to the Lord; with my voice to God, and He paid attention to me.
verses.76:3: In the day of my tribulation I sought out God, with my hands by night before Him, and I was not deceived. My soul refused to be comforted;
verses.76:4: I was mindful of God, and I was delighted, and I was exercised, and my spirit failed.
verses.76:5: My eyes anticipated the watches; I was troubled, and I did not speak.
verses.76:6: I thought of the ancient days, and I had the eternal years in mind.
verses.76:7: And I meditated by night with my heart, and I was exercised, and I swept my spirit.
verses.76:8: Will God cast off forever? Or will He not go on to be more favorable still?
verses.76:9: Or will He cut off His mercy to the end, from generation to generation?
verses.76:10: Or will God forget to have mercy? Or will He hold back His mercies in His wrath?
verses.76:11: And I said, "Now I have begun; this is the change of the right hand of the Most High."
verses.76:12: I was mindful of the works of the Lord, for I will be mindful of Your wonders from the beginning;
verses.76:13: and I will meditate on all Your works, and I will be exercised in Your designs.
verses.76:14: God, Your way is in the holy place; what god is as great as our God?
verses.76:15: You are the God who performs wonders; You made Your power known among the peoples.
verses.76:16: You redeemed Your people with Your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph.
verses.76:17: The waters saw You, God; the waters saw You and feared, and the depths were troubled.
verses.76:18: There was a multitude of the sound of waters; the clouds gave voice. Indeed, Your arrows pass through;
verses.76:19: the voice of Your thunder is in the wheel. Your lightning flashes lit up the world; the earth was shaken and trembled.
verses.76:20: In the sea is Your way, and Your paths are in many waters, and Your footprints will not be known.
verses.76:21: You led Your people like sheep, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.77:1: Understanding of Asaph. Pay attention, my people, to my law; incline your ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.77:2: I will open my mouth in parables; I will speak riddles from the beginning.
verses.77:3: All the things that we have heard and known, and that our fathers have recounted to us,
verses.77:4: have not been hidden from their children in another generation, recounting the praises of the Lord and His mighty deeds, and His wonders that He performed.
verses.77:5: And He raised up a testimony in Jacob, and set a law in Israel, all the things that He commanded our fathers to make known to their children,
verses.77:6: so that another generation might know: the children who will be born and will rise up, and they will recount them to their children,
verses.77:7: so that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, and seek out His commands,
verses.77:8: so that they might not become, like their fathers, a crooked and provoking generation, a generation that did not direct its heart; and its spirit was not faithful with God.
verses.77:9: The sons of Ephraim, drawing and shooting the bow, turned back on the day of battle.
verses.77:10: They did not keep the covenant of God, and they were unwilling to walk in His law.
verses.77:11: And they forgot His good deeds, and His wonders that He showed them.
verses.77:12: Before their fathers He performed wonders in the land of Egypt, in the plain of Tanis.
verses.77:13: He split open the sea and led them through, and made the waters stand as in a wineskin.
verses.77:14: And He led them in a cloud by day, and the whole night in the light of fire.
verses.77:15: He split open the rock in the wilderness, and gave them drink as in a great deep.
verses.77:16: And He brought water out of the rock, and brought down waters like rivers.
verses.77:17: And they continued still to sin against Him; they provoked the Most High to wrath in a waterless place.
verses.77:18: And they tested God in their hearts to ask for food for their souls.
verses.77:19: And they spoke evil of God; they said, "Will God really be able to prepare a table in the desert?
verses.77:20: Since He struck the rock, and waters flowed, and torrents overflowed, will He also be able to give bread, or prepare a table for His people?"
verses.77:21: Therefore the Lord heard and delayed; and a fire was kindled in Jacob, and wrath rose up against Israel,
verses.77:22: because they did not believe in God, nor did they hope in His salvation.
verses.77:23: And He commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven.
verses.77:24: And He rained down manna for them to eat, and gave them the bread of heaven.
verses.77:25: The bread of angels man ate; He sent provisions to them in abundance.
verses.77:26: He moved the south wind from heaven, and brought in the southwest wind by His might.
verses.77:27: And He rained down upon them meat like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea.
verses.77:28: And they fell in the midst of their camp, around their tents.
verses.77:29: And they ate and were greatly satisfied, and He brought their desire to them;
verses.77:30: they were not deprived of their desire. Their food was still in their mouth,
verses.77:31: and the wrath of God rose up over them; and He killed their fat ones, and entangled the chosen ones of Israel.
verses.77:32: In all these things they still sinned, and did not believe in His wonders.
verses.77:33: And their days ended in emptiness, and their years with haste.
verses.77:34: When He killed them, they sought Him and returned, and at dawn they came to Him.
verses.77:35: And they remembered that God is their helper, and the Most High God is their redeemer.
verses.77:36: And they loved Him with their mouth, and with their tongue they lied to Him.
verses.77:37: But their heart was not right with Him, nor were they counted faithful in His covenant.
verses.77:38: But He is merciful, and He will be forgiving toward their sins, and will not destroy them. And He abounded in turning away His wrath, and did not kindle all His wrath.
verses.77:39: And He remembered that they are flesh, a wind going and not returning.
verses.77:40: How often did they provoke Him in the desert, rouse Him to wrath in a waterless place?
verses.77:41: And they turned back and tested God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
verses.77:42: They did not remember His hand, on the day when He redeemed them from the hand of the oppressor,
verses.77:43: how He set His signs in Egypt, and His portents in the plain of Tanis;
verses.77:44: and He turned their rivers into blood, and their rains, so that they could not drink.
verses.77:45: He sent among them the dog-fly, and it devoured them, and the frog, and it destroyed them;
verses.77:46: and He gave their fruits to the blight, and their labors to the locust;
verses.77:47: and He killed their vineyards with hail, and their mulberry trees with frost;
verses.77:48: and He handed over their livestock to the hail, and their property to fire.
verses.77:49: He sent upon them the wrath of His indignation, indignation and wrath and tribulation, visitations through evil angels.
verses.77:50: He made a way for the path of His wrath; He did not spare their souls from death, and He shut up their livestock in death.
verses.77:51: And He struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt, the firstfruits of all their labor in the tents of Ham.
verses.77:52: And He led away His people like sheep, and led them through like a flock in the desert.
verses.77:53: And He led them in hope, and they did not fear, and the sea covered their enemies.
verses.77:54: And He brought them into the mountain of His sanctification, the mountain that His right hand acquired; and He cast out the nations from before their face, and He divided the land for them by lot with a line of distribution,
verses.77:55: and He made the tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.
verses.77:56: And they tested and provoked the Most High God, and did not keep His testimonies.
verses.77:57: And they turned away and did not observe the pact; just like their fathers, they were turned into a crooked bow.
verses.77:58: They roused Him to wrath on their hills, and with their carved images they provoked Him to jealousy.
verses.77:59: God heard, and despised and utterly reduced Israel to nothing.
verses.77:60: And He rejected the tent of Shiloh, His own tent, where He dwelt among people.
verses.77:61: And He handed over their might into captivity, and their beauty into the hands of the enemy.
verses.77:62: And He shut up His people under the sword, and despised His inheritance.
verses.77:63: Fire devoured their young men, and their virgins were not lamented.
verses.77:64: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows were not wept for.
verses.77:65: And the Lord was awakened like one sleeping, like a mighty man intoxicated from wine.
verses.77:66: And He struck His enemies in the rear; He gave them everlasting reproach.
verses.77:67: And He rejected the tent of Joseph, and He did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;
verses.77:68: but He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
verses.77:69: And He built His sanctuary like that of unicorns, on the earth that He founded forever.
verses.77:70: And He chose David His servant, and took him up from the flocks of sheep; He took him from behind the ewes with young,
verses.77:71: to shepherd Jacob His servant, and Israel His inheritance.
verses.77:72: And he shepherded them in the innocence of his heart, and with the understanding of his hands he led them.
verses.78:1: A psalm of Asaph. God, the nations have come into Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple; they have made Jerusalem into a watch-post for fruit.
verses.78:2: They have made the corpses of Your servants food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of Your holy ones for the beasts of the earth.
verses.78:3: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there was no one to bury them.
verses.78:4: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and ridicule to those who are all around us.
verses.78:5: How long, Lord, will You be angry to the end? Will Your zeal be kindled like fire?
verses.78:6: Pour out Your wrath upon the nations that do not know You, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon Your name,
verses.78:7: for they have devoured Jacob and have made his place desolate.
verses.78:8: Do not remember our former iniquities; let Your mercies quickly come to meet us, for we have become exceedingly poor.
verses.78:9: Help us, God our Savior, and for the sake of the glory of Your name, Lord, deliver us, and be merciful toward our sins, for the sake of Your name.
verses.78:10: May they never say among the nations, "Where is their God?" And let the avenging of the blood of Your servants that has been poured out become known among the peoples before our eyes.
verses.78:11: Let the groaning of those in shackles enter into Your presence; according to the greatness of Your arm, take possession of the sons of those put to death,
verses.78:12: and pay back to our neighbors sevenfold into their lap, their own reproach with which they have reproached You, Lord.
verses.78:13: But we, Your people and the sheep of Your pasture, will give thanks to You forever; to generation after generation we will proclaim Your praise.
verses.79:1: To the end, for those who will be changed. A testimony of Asaph, a psalm.
verses.79:2: You who rule Israel, pay attention; You who lead Joseph like a sheep. You who sit above the cherubim, appear
verses.79:3: before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Stir up Your power, and come so that You may save us.
verses.79:4: God, turn us back, and show Your face, and we will be saved.
verses.79:5: Lord God of hosts, how long will You be angry against the prayer of Your servant?
verses.79:6: Will You feed us with the bread of tears and give us tears to drink by measure?
verses.79:7: You have made us a cause of contention to our neighbors, and our enemies have mocked us.
verses.79:8: God of hosts, turn us back, and show Your face, and we will be saved.
verses.79:9: You transplanted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and planted it.
verses.79:10: You were the leader of the journey before it; You planted its roots, and it filled the land.
verses.79:11: Its shadow covered the mountains, and its boughs the cedars of God.
verses.79:12: It stretched out its branches as far as the sea, and its offshoots as far as the river.
verses.79:13: Why have You torn down its stone wall, so that all who pass along the way harvest its grapes?
verses.79:14: The boar from the forest has ravaged it, and the solitary wild beast has fed upon it.
verses.79:15: God of hosts, turn back; look down from heaven and see, and visit this vine,
verses.79:16: and perfect the one that Your right hand planted, and upon the son of man whom You have strengthened for Yourself.
verses.79:17: It is burned with fire and dug up; at the rebuke of Your countenance they will perish.
verses.79:18: Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, and upon the son of man whom You have strengthened for Yourself.
verses.79:19: And we do not depart from You; You will give us life, and we will call upon Your name.
verses.79:20: Lord God of hosts, turn us back, and show Your face, and we will be saved.
verses.80:1: To the end, for the winepresses. A psalm for Asaph himself.
verses.80:2: Exult in God our helper; shout joyfully to the God of Jacob.
verses.80:3: Take up a psalm, and bring the tambourine, the pleasant harp with the lyre.
verses.80:4: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, on the notable day of your solemn feast,
verses.80:5: for it is a precept in Israel and a judgment for the God of Jacob.
verses.80:6: He set it as a testimony in Joseph when he went out from the land of Egypt; he heard a language that he did not know.
verses.80:7: He turned his back away from the burdens; his hands served in the basket.
verses.80:8: In affliction you called upon Me, and I delivered you. I heard you in the hidden place of the storm; I tested you at the water of contention.
verses.80:9: Listen, My people, and I will admonish you. Israel, if you will listen to Me,
verses.80:10: there will be no new god among you, nor will you worship a foreign god.
verses.80:11: For I am the Lord your God, who led you out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.80:12: And My people did not listen to My voice, and Israel did not pay attention to Me.
verses.80:13: And I let them go according to the desires of their heart; they will walk in their own schemes.
verses.80:14: If My people had listened to Me, if Israel had walked in My ways,
verses.80:15: perhaps for nothing I would have humbled their enemies, and I would have laid My hand upon those who afflict them.
verses.80:16: The enemies of the Lord have lied to Him, and their time will be forever.
verses.80:17: And He fed them from the fat of wheat, and from the rock He satisfied them with honey.
verses.81:1: A psalm of Asaph. God has stood in the assembly of the gods, and in the midst He passes judgment on the gods.
verses.81:2: "How long do you judge unjustly and show partiality to sinners?
verses.81:3: Judge for the needy and the orphan; vindicate the humble and the poor.
verses.81:4: Rescue the poor, and free the needy from the hand of the sinner.
verses.81:5: They have neither known nor understood; they walk in darkness; all the foundations of the earth will be shaken.
verses.81:6: I said, 'You are gods, and you are all sons of the Most High.'
verses.81:7: Yet you will die like men, and like one of the princes you will fall."
verses.81:8: Arise, God, judge the earth, for You will inherit among all the nations.
verses.82:1: A song of a psalm of Asaph.
verses.82:2: God, who will be like You? Do not keep silent, nor be restrained, God,
verses.82:3: for look, Your enemies have roared, and those who hate You have lifted their heads.
verses.82:4: Against Your people they have wickedly devised a plan, and they have plotted against Your holy ones.
verses.82:5: They said, "Come, and let us destroy them from being a nation, and let the name of Israel not be remembered any longer."
verses.82:6: For they have plotted with one mind; together they have formed a covenant against You:
verses.82:7: the tents of the Edomites and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
verses.82:8: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; the foreigners with those who dwell in Tyre.
verses.82:9: For indeed, Assyria has come with them; they have become an aid to the sons of Lot.
verses.82:10: Do to them as to Midian and Sisera, as to Jabin at the Kishon torrent.
verses.82:11: They perished in Endor; they became like manure for the earth.
verses.82:12: Make their princes like Oreb, Zeeb, Zebah, and Zalmunna: all their princes,
verses.82:13: who said, "Let us possess the sanctuary of God by inheritance."
verses.82:14: My God, make them like a wheel, and like stubble before the face of the wind.
verses.82:15: Like a fire that burns up a forest, and like a flame burning up mountains,
verses.82:16: so You will pursue them in Your tempest, and in Your anger You will throw them into turmoil.
verses.82:17: Fill their faces with disgrace, and they will seek Your name, Lord.
verses.82:18: May they be ashamed and thrown into turmoil forever and ever, and may they be humiliated and perish.
verses.82:19: And may they know that Your name is the Lord: You alone are the Most High in all the earth.
verses.83:1: To the end, for the winepresses, for the sons of Korah. A psalm.
verses.83:2: How beloved are Your dwelling places, Lord of hosts!
verses.83:3: My soul yearns and faints for the courts of the Lord; my heart and my flesh have exulted in the living God.
verses.83:4: For indeed, the sparrow has found a house for itself, and the turtledove a nest for itself, where it may place its young: Your altars, Lord of hosts, my King and my God.
verses.83:5: Blessed are those who dwell in Your house, Lord; forever and ever they will praise You.
verses.83:6: Blessed is the man whose help is from You: he has arranged ascents in his heart,
verses.83:7: in the valley of tears, in the place that he has set.
verses.83:8: For indeed, the lawgiver will give a blessing; they will go from strength to strength; the God of gods will be seen in Zion.
verses.83:9: Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; listen with Your ears, God of Jacob.
verses.83:10: Our Protector, look, God, and look upon the face of Your anointed.
verses.83:11: For one day in Your courts is better than thousands; I have chosen to be lowly in the house of my God rather than to dwell in the tents of sinners.
verses.83:12: For God loves mercy and truth; the Lord will give grace and glory.
verses.83:13: He will not deprive those who walk in innocence of good things; Lord of hosts, blessed is the person who hopes in You.
verses.84:1: To the end, for the sons of Korah. A psalm.
verses.84:2: You blessed Your land, Lord; You turned away the captivity of Jacob.
verses.84:3: You pardoned the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sins.
verses.84:4: You calmed all Your anger; You turned away from the anger of Your indignation.
verses.84:5: Turn us back, God our Savior, and turn Your anger away from us.
verses.84:6: Will You be angry with us forever? Or will You stretch out Your anger from generation to generation?
verses.84:7: God, turning back, You will give us life, and Your people will rejoice in You.
verses.84:8: Show us Your mercy, Lord, and give us Your salvation.
verses.84:9: I will hear what the Lord God speaks in me, for He will speak peace to His people, and upon His holy ones, and to those who turn back to the heart.
verses.84:10: Yet truly, close to those who fear Him is His salvation, so that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.84:11: Mercy and truth have met one another; righteousness and peace have kissed.
verses.84:12: Truth has sprung up from the earth, and righteousness has looked down from heaven.
verses.84:13: For indeed, the Lord will give goodness, and our land will give its fruit.
verses.84:14: Righteousness will walk before Him, and will set its steps in the way.
verses.85:1: A prayer of David himself. Bend down Your ear, Lord, and hear me, for I am destitute and poor.
verses.85:2: Guard my soul, for I am holy; save Your servant, my God, who hopes in You.
verses.85:3: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I have cried out to You all day long;
verses.85:4: gladden the soul of Your servant, for to You, Lord, I have lifted up my soul.
verses.85:5: For You, Lord, are sweet and gentle, and abundant in mercy to all who call upon You.
verses.85:6: Receive my prayer with Your ears, Lord, and heed the voice of my supplication.
verses.85:7: In the day of my distress I cried out to You, because You heard me.
verses.85:8: There is no one like You among the gods, Lord, and there is nothing comparable to Your works.
verses.85:9: All the nations, as many as You have made, will come and worship before You, Lord, and will glorify Your name.
verses.85:10: For You are great and do wonders; You are God alone.
verses.85:11: Lead me, Lord, in Your way, and I will walk in Your truth; let my heart rejoice, so that it may fear Your name.
verses.85:12: I will give praise to You, Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify Your name forever:
verses.85:13: because Your mercy is great upon me, and You have rescued my soul from the lower hell.
verses.85:14: God, the unjust have risen up against me, and an assembly of the powerful has sought my soul, and they have not placed You in their sight.
verses.85:15: And You, Lord God, are compassionate and merciful, patient, and abundant in mercy, and truthful.
verses.85:16: Look upon me, and have mercy on me; give Your dominion to Your servant, and save the son of Your maidservant.
verses.85:17: Work a sign with me for good, so that those who hate me may see and be put to shame, because You, Lord, have helped me and comforted me.
verses.86:1: For the sons of Korah. A psalm of a song. Her foundations are in the holy mountains;
verses.86:2: the Lord loves the gates of Zion above all the tents of Jacob.
verses.86:3: Glorious things have been spoken about you, city of God!
verses.86:4: I will be mindful of Rahab and Babylon, of those who know Me; look, foreigners, and Tyre, and the people of the Ethiopians: these were there.
verses.86:5: Will Zion say, "Man and man was born in her, and the Most High Himself founded her"?
verses.86:6: The Lord will recount in the writings of peoples and of princes, of those who were in her.
verses.86:7: The dwelling in you is like that of all who rejoice.
verses.87:1: A song of a psalm, for the sons of Korah, to the end, for Mahalath, to respond. Understanding of Heman the Ezrahite.
verses.87:2: Lord, God of my salvation, by day I have cried out, and by night before You.
verses.87:3: Let my prayer enter into Your sight; incline Your ear to my plea.
verses.87:4: For my soul has been filled with evils, and my life has drawn near to the underworld.
verses.87:5: I have been counted with those going down into the pit; I have become like a man without help,
verses.87:6: free among the dead; like the wounded sleeping in tombs, of whom You are no longer mindful, and they themselves have been cast away from Your hand.
verses.87:7: They have placed me in the lower pit, in dark places, and in the shadow of death.
verses.87:8: Upon me Your fury has been firmly set, and You have brought all Your waves upon me.
verses.87:9: You have put my acquaintances far from me; they have made me an abomination to themselves. I was handed over, and I did not go out;
verses.87:10: my eyes have grown faint from want. I have cried out to You, Lord, all day long; I have stretched out my hands to You.
verses.87:11: Will You perform wonders for the dead? Or will physicians raise them up, and will they praise You?
verses.87:12: Will anyone recount Your mercy in the tomb, and Your truth in destruction?
verses.87:13: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, and Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.87:14: And I have cried out to You, Lord, and in the morning my prayer will come before You.
verses.87:15: Why, Lord, do You reject my prayer and turn Your face away from me?
verses.87:16: I am poor, and in labors from my youth; yet having been exalted, I have been humbled and deeply troubled.
verses.87:17: Over me Your wraths have passed, and Your terrors have deeply troubled me;
verses.87:18: they have surrounded me like water all day long; they have surrounded me together.
verses.87:19: You have removed friend and neighbor far from me, and my acquaintances because of misery.
verses.88:2: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord forever; to generation after generation I will proclaim Your truth with my mouth.
verses.88:3: For You have said, "Mercy will be built up forever in the heavens; Your truth will be prepared in them.
verses.88:4: I have ordained a covenant for My chosen ones; I have sworn to David My servant:
verses.88:5: 'Forevermore I will prepare your offspring, and I will build up your throne to generation after generation.'"
verses.88:6: The heavens will praise Your wonders, Lord, and indeed Your truth in the assembly of the holy ones.
verses.88:7: For who in the clouds will be equal to the Lord, or be like God among the sons of God?
verses.88:8: God, who is glorified in the council of the holy ones, is great and fearsome above all who are around Him.
verses.88:9: Lord God of hosts, who is like You? You are mighty, Lord, and Your truth is around You.
verses.88:10: You rule over the power of the sea, and You calm the motion of its waves.
verses.88:11: You have humbled the proud one like a wounded man; with the arm of Your strength You have scattered Your enemies.
verses.88:12: Yours are the heavens, and Yours is the earth; the world and its fullness You have founded;
verses.88:13: the north and the sea You have created. Tabor and Hermon will exult in Your name.
verses.88:14: Your arm is with power. Let Your hand be made firm, and let Your right hand be exalted.
verses.88:15: Righteousness and judgment are the preparation of Your throne; mercy and truth will go before Your face.
verses.88:16: Blessed is the people that knows jubilation; Lord, they will walk in the light of Your countenance,
verses.88:17: and in Your name they will exult all day long, and in Your righteousness they will be exalted.
verses.88:18: For You are the glory of their strength, and in Your good pleasure our horn will be exalted.
verses.88:19: For our support belongs to the Lord, and to the Holy One of Israel, our King.
verses.88:20: Then You spoke in a vision to Your holy ones, and said, "I have placed help upon a mighty one, and I have exalted a chosen one from My people.
verses.88:21: I have found David, My servant; with My holy oil I have anointed him.
verses.88:22: For My hand will aid him, and My arm will strengthen him.
verses.88:23: The enemy will gain nothing against him, and the son of iniquity will not proceed to harm him.
verses.88:24: And I will cut down his enemies from before his face, and those who hate him I will turn to flight.
verses.88:25: And My truth and My mercy will be with him, and in My name his horn will be exalted.
verses.88:26: And I will place his hand upon the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
