verses.88:27: He will call upon Me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the upholder of my salvation.'
verses.88:28: And I will make him the firstborn, high above the kings of the earth.
verses.88:29: Forever I will keep My mercy for him, and My covenant will be faithful to him.
verses.88:30: And I will set his offspring forever and ever, and his throne like the days of heaven.
verses.88:31: But if his sons abandon My law, and do not walk in My judgments;
verses.88:32: if they profane My ordinances, and do not keep My commandments:
verses.88:33: I will visit their iniquities with a rod, and their sins with lashes;
verses.88:34: yet I will not scatter My mercy from him, nor will I do harm in My truth,
verses.88:35: nor will I profane My covenant, and what proceeds from My lips I will not make void.
verses.88:36: Once I have sworn by My holiness, I will not lie to David:
verses.88:37: his offspring will remain forever. And his throne will be like the sun in My sight,
verses.88:38: and like the moon perfected forever, and a faithful witness in heaven."
verses.88:39: Yet You have rejected and despised; You have put off Your anointed one.
verses.88:40: You have overturned the covenant of Your servant; You have profaned his sanctuary on the ground.
verses.88:41: You have destroyed all his hedges; You have made his stronghold a terror.
verses.88:42: All who pass along the way have plundered him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.88:43: You have exalted the right hand of those who oppress him; You have made all his enemies glad.
verses.88:44: You have turned away the help of his sword, and You have not aided him in war.
verses.88:45: You have destroyed him from purification, and You have dashed his throne to the ground.
verses.88:46: You have shortened the days of his time; You have poured shame over him.
verses.88:47: How long, Lord, do You turn away to the end? Will Your wrath blaze up like fire?
verses.88:48: Remember what my substance is; for have You established all the sons of men in vain?
verses.88:49: Who is the man who will live and not see death? Will he deliver his soul from the hand of the underworld?
verses.88:50: Where are Your ancient mercies, Lord, as You swore to David in Your truth?
verses.88:51: Be mindful, Lord, of the reproach of Your servants, which I have held in my bosom, of many nations,
verses.88:52: with which Your enemies have cast reproach, Lord; with which they have reproached the exchange of Your anointed one.
verses.88:53: Blessed be the Lord forever. So be it, so be it.
verses.89:1: A prayer of Moses, the man of God. Lord, You have become a refuge for us from generation to generation.
verses.89:2: Before the mountains came into being, or the earth and the world were formed, from eternity even to eternity You are, God.
verses.89:3: Do not turn man away into lowliness; and You said, "Turn back, sons of men."
verses.89:4: For a thousand years before Your eyes are like yesterday that has passed by, and a watch in the night;
verses.89:5: things that are counted as nothing will be their years.
verses.89:6: In the morning he may pass away like grass; in the morning he may flourish and pass away; in the evening he may fall, grow hard, and dry up.
verses.89:7: Because we have faded away in Your wrath, and in Your fury we have been troubled.
verses.89:8: You have set our iniquities in Your sight, our age in the illumination of Your face.
verses.89:9: For all our days have faded away, and in Your wrath we have faded away. Our years will meditate like a spider;
verses.89:10: the days of our years in them are seventy years. But if in strength, eighty years, and the greater part of them is toil and pain; for gentleness has arrived, and we will be corrected.
verses.89:11: Who knows the power of Your wrath, and for fear of You
verses.89:12: how to count Your wrath? Make Your right hand known in this way, and those instructed in heart in wisdom.
verses.89:13: Turn back, Lord; how long? And be moved by prayer toward Your servants.
verses.89:14: We have been filled in the morning with Your mercy, and we have exulted and been delighted all our days.
verses.89:15: We have been glad for the days in which You humbled us, the years in which we saw evils.
verses.89:16: Look upon Your servants and upon Your works, and direct their sons.
verses.89:17: And may the splendor of the Lord our God be upon us, and direct the works of our hands upon us, and direct the work of our hands.
verses.90:1: Praise of a song of David. He who dwells in the help of the Most High will remain in the protection of the God of heaven.
verses.90:2: He will say to the Lord, "You are my upholder and my refuge; my God, I will hope in Him."
verses.90:3: For He Himself has delivered me from the snare of the hunters, and from a harsh word.
verses.90:4: With His shoulders He will overshadow you, and under His wings you will hope.
verses.90:5: His truth will surround you with a shield; you will not be afraid of terror by night,
verses.90:6: of the arrow flying by day, of the matter walking about in darkness, of assault and the noonday demon.
verses.90:7: A thousand will fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; yet it will not draw near to you.
verses.90:8: Nevertheless, with your eyes you will observe, and you will see the retribution of sinners.
verses.90:9: For You, Lord, are my hope; you have set the Most High as your refuge.
verses.90:10: No evil will approach you, and no scourge will draw near to your tent.
verses.90:11: For He has commanded His angels regarding you, that they may guard you in all your ways.
verses.90:12: In their hands they will carry you, so that you do not by chance strike your foot against a stone.
verses.90:13: Upon the asp and the basilisk you will walk, and you will trample the lion and the dragon.
verses.90:14: "Because he has hoped in Me, I will deliver him; I will protect him, because he has known My name.
verses.90:15: He will cry out to Me, and I will hear him; I am with him in tribulation; I will rescue him, and I will glorify him.
verses.90:16: With length of days I will fill him, and I will show him My salvation."
verses.91:1: A psalm of a song, on the Sabbath day.
verses.91:2: It is good to give thanks to the Lord, and to sing psalms to Your name, Most High,
verses.91:3: to declare Your mercy in the morning, and Your truth through the night,
verses.91:4: on a ten-stringed instrument, the psaltery; with a song, on the lyre.
verses.91:5: For You have delighted me, Lord, in Your handiwork; and in the works of Your hands I will exult.
verses.91:6: How magnified are Your works, Lord! Your thoughts have become exceedingly deep.
verses.91:7: An unwise man will not know, and a fool will not understand these things.
verses.91:8: When sinners have sprung up like grass, and all who work iniquity have appeared, so that they may perish forever and ever,
verses.91:9: yet You are the Most High forever, Lord.
verses.91:10: For look, Your enemies, Lord, for look, Your enemies will perish; and all who work iniquity will be scattered.
verses.91:11: And my horn will be exalted like that of a unicorn, and my old age in rich mercy.
verses.91:12: And my eye has looked down on my enemies, and my ear will hear concerning the evildoers rising up against me.
verses.91:13: The righteous one will flourish like a palm tree; like a cedar of Lebanon he will be multiplied.
verses.91:14: Planted in the house of the Lord, they will flourish in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.91:15: They will still be multiplied in a rich old age, and they will be well-enduring,
verses.91:16: so that they may declare that the Lord our God is upright, and there is no iniquity in Him.
verses.92:1: Praise of a song for David himself, on the day before the Sabbath, when the earth was founded. The Lord has reigned; He has clothed Himself with splendor. The Lord has clothed Himself with strength and girded Himself. For indeed He has made the world firm, which will not be shaken.
verses.92:2: Your throne is prepared from then; You are from eternity.
verses.92:3: The rivers have lifted up, Lord, the rivers have lifted up their voice; the rivers have lifted up their waves,
verses.92:4: from the voices of many waters. Marvelous are the swellings of the sea; marvelous is the Lord in the heights.
verses.92:5: Your testimonies have become exceedingly trustworthy; holiness is fitting for Your house, Lord, for length of days.
verses.93:1: A psalm for David himself, on the fourth day of the week. The Lord is the God of vengeances; the God of vengeances has acted freely.
verses.93:2: Be exalted, You who judge the earth; render retribution to the proud.
verses.93:3: How long will sinners, Lord, how long will sinners boast;
verses.93:4: will they utter and speak iniquity; will all who work injustice speak?
verses.93:5: They have humbled Your people, Lord, and they have afflicted Your inheritance.
verses.93:6: They have killed the widow and the sojourner, and they have murdered the orphans.
verses.93:7: And they have said, "The Lord will not see, nor will the God of Jacob understand."
verses.93:8: Understand, you unwise ones among the people; and you fools, finally be wise.
verses.93:9: Will He who planted the ear not hear? Or does He who fashioned the eye not observe?
verses.93:10: Will He who disciplines the nations not reprove, He who teaches man knowledge?
verses.93:11: The Lord knows the thoughts of men, that they are futile.
verses.93:12: Blessed is the man whom You instruct, Lord, and whom You teach from Your law,
verses.93:13: so that You may relieve him from evil days, until a pit is dug for the sinner.
verses.93:14: For the Lord will not reject His people, and He will not abandon His inheritance,
verses.93:15: until righteousness is turned into judgment, and those who are close to it are all who are upright in heart.
verses.93:16: Who will rise up for me against those who do evil? Or who will stand with me against those who work iniquity?
verses.93:17: If the Lord had not helped me, my soul would nearly have dwelt in the underworld.
verses.93:18: If I said, "My foot has been moved," Your mercy, Lord, kept helping me.
verses.93:19: According to the multitude of my sorrows in my heart, Your consolations have gladdened my soul.
verses.93:20: Does a throne of iniquity cling to You, who fashion toil in a precept?
verses.93:21: They will hunt for the soul of the righteous one, and they will condemn innocent blood.
verses.93:22: And the Lord has become a refuge for me, and my God a help of my hope.
verses.93:23: And He will repay them their own iniquity, and in their wickedness He will utterly destroy them; the Lord our God will utterly destroy them.
verses.94:1: Praise of a song for David himself. Come, let us exult to the Lord; let us shout for joy to God our Savior;
verses.94:2: let us come before His face with thanksgiving, and in psalms let us shout for joy to Him,
verses.94:3: because the Lord is a great God, and a great King over all gods.
verses.94:4: For all the ends of the earth are in His hand, and the heights of the mountains belong to Him;
verses.94:5: since the sea belongs to Him, and He Himself made it, and His hands shaped the dry land.
verses.94:6: Come, let us worship and fall down, and let us weep before the Lord who made us,
verses.94:7: for He Himself is the Lord our God, and we are the people of His pasture and the sheep of His hand.
verses.94:8: Today, if you listen to His voice, do not harden your hearts,
verses.94:9: as in the provocation, according to the day of testing in the desert, where your fathers tested Me; they put Me to the proof and saw My works.
verses.94:10: For forty years I was offended by that generation, and I said, "These always go astray in heart."
verses.94:11: And they have not known My ways; as I swore in My wrath, "They will not enter into My rest."
verses.95:1: A song for David himself, when the house was being built after the captivity. Sing a new song to the Lord; sing to the Lord, all the earth.
verses.95:2: Sing to the Lord, and bless His name; proclaim His salvation from day to day.
verses.95:3: Proclaim His glory among the nations; among all the peoples, His marvelous deeds.
verses.95:4: For the Lord is great, and exceedingly praiseworthy: He is fearsome above all gods.
verses.95:5: For all the gods of the nations are demons; but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.95:6: Thanksgiving and beauty are in His sight; holiness and magnificence are in His sanctuary.
verses.95:7: Bring to the Lord, families of the nations, bring to the Lord glory and honor;
verses.95:8: bring to the Lord glory for His name. Take up sacrifices, and enter into His courts;
verses.95:9: worship the Lord in His holy court. Let the whole earth be shaken before His face;
verses.95:10: say among the nations that the Lord has reigned. For indeed He has set right the world, which will not be shaken; He will judge the peoples in equity.
verses.95:11: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth exult; let the sea and its fullness be shaken;
verses.95:12: the fields will rejoice, and all things that are in them. Then all the trees of the forests will exult
verses.95:13: before the face of the Lord, because He is coming, for He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in equity, and the peoples in His truth.
verses.96:1: For this David, when his land was restored. The Lord has reigned: let the earth exult; let many islands be glad.
verses.96:2: Cloud and thick darkness are all around Him; righteousness and judgment are the right ordering of His throne.
verses.96:3: Fire will go before Him, and will set His enemies ablaze all around.
verses.96:4: His lightning flashes shone upon the world; the earth saw, and was shaken.
verses.96:5: The mountains melted like wax before the face of the Lord; before the face of the Lord, all the earth.
verses.96:6: The heavens have proclaimed His righteousness, and all the peoples have seen His glory.
verses.96:7: Let all be put to shame who worship carved images, and who boast in their idols. Worship Him, all His angels.
verses.96:8: Zion heard, and was glad, and the daughters of Judah exulted because of Your judgments, Lord.
verses.96:9: For You are the Lord Most High over all the earth; You are exceedingly exalted above all gods.
verses.96:10: You who love the Lord, hate evil: the Lord guards the souls of His holy ones; He will deliver them from the hand of the sinner.
verses.96:11: Light has risen for the righteous one, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.96:12: Be glad, you righteous, in the Lord, and give thanks to the remembrance of His holiness.
verses.97:1: A psalm for David himself. Sing a new song to the Lord, for He has done marvelous deeds. His right hand has brought salvation for Himself, and His holy arm.
verses.97:2: The Lord has made His salvation known; in the sight of the nations He has revealed His righteousness.
verses.97:3: He has remembered His mercy and His truth to the house of Israel. All the bounds of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.97:4: Shout with joy to God, all the earth; sing, and exult, and sing psalms.
verses.97:5: Sing psalms to the Lord with the lyre; with the lyre and the sound of a psalm;
verses.97:6: with hammered trumpets, and the sound of a horn trumpet. Shout with joy in the sight of the King, the Lord:
verses.97:7: let the sea be moved, and its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
verses.97:8: The rivers will clap their hands; together the mountains will exult
verses.97:9: before the presence of the Lord: for He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness, and the peoples in equity.
verses.98:1: A psalm of David himself. The Lord has reigned: let the peoples be angry; He who sits above the cherubim: let the earth be shaken.
verses.98:2: The Lord is great in Zion, and lofty above all the peoples.
verses.98:3: Let them give thanks to Your great name, for it is fearsome and holy,
verses.98:4: and the honor of the king loves judgment. You have prepared straight courses; You have carried out judgment and justice in Jacob.
verses.98:5: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship the footstool of His feet, for it is holy.
verses.98:6: Moses and Aaron among His priests, and Samuel among those who call upon His name: they called upon the Lord, and He Himself heard them;
verses.98:7: in a pillar of cloud He spoke to them. They kept His testimonies and the precept that He gave them.
verses.98:8: Lord our God, You heard them; God, You were gracious to them, and taking vengeance on all their devices.
verses.98:9: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship on His holy mountain, for the Lord our God is holy.
verses.99:2: Shout with joy to God, all the earth; serve the Lord in gladness. Enter into His presence with exultation.
verses.99:3: Know that the Lord Himself is God; He Himself made us, and not we ourselves: His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
verses.99:4: Enter His gates with thanksgiving, His courts with hymns; give thanks to Him. Praise His name,
verses.99:5: for the Lord is sweet; His mercy is forever, and His truth even to generation and generation.
verses.100:1: A psalm of David himself. I will sing of mercy and judgment to You, Lord; I will sing praises,
verses.100:2: and I will understand in an undefiled way: when will You come to me? I walked about in the innocence of my heart, in the midst of my house.
verses.100:3: I did not set an unjust thing before my eyes; I hated those who commit transgressions; there did not cling to me
verses.100:4: a perverse heart; I did not know the wicked one turning away from me.
verses.100:5: The one slandering his neighbor in secret, him I pursued; one with a proud eye and an insatiable heart, with him I did not eat.
verses.100:6: My eyes are toward the faithful of the earth, so that they may sit with me; the one walking in an undefiled way, he ministered to me.
verses.100:7: The one who practices pride will not dwell in the midst of my house; the one who speaks iniquitous things did not succeed in the sight of my eyes.
verses.100:8: In the morning I put to death all the sinners of the earth, so that I might wipe out from the city of the Lord all who work iniquity.
verses.101:1: A prayer of a poor man, when he is distressed and pours out his petition in the sight of the Lord.
verses.101:2: Lord, hear my prayer, and let my cry come to You.
verses.101:3: Do not turn Your face away from me: on whatever day I am afflicted, incline Your ear to me; on whatever day I call upon You, hear me quickly.
verses.101:4: For my days have vanished like smoke, and my bones have dried up like kindling.
verses.101:5: I have been struck like grass, and my heart has dried up, because I have forgotten to eat my bread.
verses.101:6: From the sound of my groaning, my bone has clung to my flesh.
verses.101:7: I have become like a pelican of the wilderness; I have become like a night owl in a dwelling.
verses.101:8: I have stayed awake, and I have become like a solitary sparrow on a roof.
verses.101:9: All day long my enemies reproached me, and those who praised me swore against me:
verses.101:10: for I ate ashes like bread and mixed my drink with weeping,
verses.101:11: because of Your wrath and indignation: for, lifting me up, You have dashed me down.
verses.101:12: My days have declined like a shadow, and I have dried up like grass.
verses.101:13: But You, Lord, remain forever, and Your remembrance from generation to generation.
verses.101:14: Rising up, You will have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have mercy on her, for the time has come:
verses.101:15: since her stones have pleased Your servants, and they will have pity on her earth.
verses.101:16: And the nations will fear Your name, Lord, and all the kings of the earth Your glory:
verses.101:17: for the Lord has built Zion, and He will be seen in His glory.
verses.101:18: He has looked upon the prayer of the humble and has not despised their petition.
verses.101:19: Let these things be written for another generation, and a people that will be created will praise the Lord.
verses.101:20: For He has looked forth from His holy height; the Lord has looked from heaven onto the earth:
verses.101:21: to hear the groans of the shackled; to release the children of those put to death;
verses.101:22: so that they may proclaim the name of the Lord in Zion, and His praise in Jerusalem,
verses.101:23: when peoples gather together as one, and kings, to serve the Lord.
verses.101:24: He answered Him in the way of his strength: "Tell me the fewness of my days;
verses.101:25: do not call me back in the middle of my days; Your years are from generation to generation.
verses.101:26: In the beginning You, Lord, founded the earth, and the works of Your hands are the heavens.
verses.101:27: They will perish, but You remain; and all of them will grow old like a garment. And like a cloak You will change them, and they will be changed;
verses.101:28: but You are the very same, and Your years will not fail.
verses.101:29: The children of Your servants will dwell, and their offspring will be directed forever."
verses.102:1: Of David himself. Bless the Lord, my soul, and everything that is within me, His holy name.
verses.102:2: Bless the Lord, my soul, and do not forget all His recompenses.
verses.102:3: It is He who pardons all your iniquities, who heals all your infirmities;
verses.102:4: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with mercy and compassion;
verses.102:5: who fills your desire with good things; your youth will be renewed like an eagle's.
verses.102:6: The Lord performs acts of mercy, and judgment for all who suffer wrong.
verses.102:7: He made His ways known to Moses; to the children of Israel, His will.
verses.102:8: Compassionate and merciful is the Lord: patient, and greatly merciful.
verses.102:9: He will not be angry perpetually, nor will He threaten forever.
verses.102:10: He has not done to us according to our sins, nor has He repaid us according to our iniquities.
verses.102:11: For according to the height of heaven above the earth, He has strengthened His mercy over those who fear Him;
verses.102:12: as far as the east is distant from the west, He has put our iniquities far from us.
verses.102:13: Just as a father has compassion on his children, the Lord has had compassion on those who fear Him.
verses.102:14: For He Himself knows our formation; He has remembered that we are dust.
verses.102:15: Man: his days are like grass; like a flower of the field, so he will blossom:
verses.102:16: for a wind will pass through him, and he will not endure, and he will no longer know his place.
verses.102:17: But the mercy of the Lord is from eternity and even to eternity upon those who fear Him. And His righteousness is to children's children,
verses.102:18: to those who keep His covenant and are mindful of His commandments to do them.
verses.102:19: The Lord has prepared His throne in heaven, and His kingdom will rule over all.
verses.102:20: Bless the Lord, all His angels, mighty in strength, doing His word, to hear the voice of His words.
verses.102:21: Bless the Lord, all His powers; His ministers, who do His will.
verses.102:22: Bless the Lord, all His works: in every place of His dominion, bless the Lord, my soul.
verses.103:1: To David himself. Bless the Lord, my soul. Lord my God, You are exceedingly magnified. You have put on praise and splendor,
verses.103:2: wrapped in light as in a garment; stretching out heaven like a skin,
verses.103:3: who cover its upper chambers with waters; who set a cloud as Your ascent; who walk upon the wings of the winds;
verses.103:4: who make Your angels spirits, and Your ministers a burning fire.
verses.103:5: You who founded the earth upon its stability: it will not be tilted forever and ever.
verses.103:6: The deep, like a garment, is its covering; above the mountains the waters will stand.
verses.103:7: At Your rebuke they will flee; at the voice of Your thunder they will be terrified.
verses.103:8: The mountains ascend, and the plains descend, to the place that You founded for them.
verses.103:9: You set a boundary that they will not cross, nor will they turn back to cover the earth.
verses.103:10: You who send forth springs in the valleys: between the mountains the waters will pass through.
verses.103:11: All the beasts of the field will drink; the wild donkeys will wait in their thirst.
verses.103:12: Above them the birds of heaven will dwell; from the midst of the rocks they will give forth voices.
verses.103:13: Watering the mountains from His upper chambers; from the fruit of Your works the earth will be satisfied;
verses.103:14: producing grass for the livestock, and vegetation for the service of men, so that You may bring forth bread from the earth,
verses.103:15: and wine may gladden the heart of man, so that he may cheer the face with oil, and bread may strengthen the heart of man.
verses.103:16: The trees of the plain will be fully satisfied, and the cedars of Lebanon which He planted;
verses.103:17: there sparrows will build nests; the house of the heron is their leader.
verses.103:18: The high mountains are for stags; the rock is a refuge for hedgehogs.
verses.103:19: He made the moon for seasons; the sun knows its setting.
verses.103:20: You set darkness, and it became night; in it all the beasts of the forest will pass through:
verses.103:21: lion cubs roaring so that they may seize prey, and seek food for themselves from God.
verses.103:22: The sun has risen, and they have gathered together, and in their lairs they will settle down.
verses.103:23: Man will go out to his work, and to his labor until evening.
verses.103:24: How magnified are Your works, Lord! You have made all things in wisdom; the earth is filled with Your possession.
verses.103:25: This sea is great and spacious of hands; there are creeping things of which there is no number: living creatures, small with great.
verses.103:26: There ships will pass through; this dragon that You formed to play with it.
verses.103:27: All things wait expectantly upon You, that You may give them food in due time.
verses.103:28: When You give to them, they will gather; when You open Your hand, all things will be filled with goodness.
verses.103:29: But when You turn Your face away, they will be troubled; You will take away their spirit, and they will fail, and they will return to their dust.
verses.103:30: You will send forth Your Spirit, and they will be created, and You will renew the face of the earth.
verses.103:31: May the glory of the Lord be forever; the Lord will rejoice in His works.
verses.103:32: He who looks upon the earth, and makes it tremble; who touches the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.103:33: I will sing to the Lord in my life; I will sing psalms to my God as long as I exist.
verses.103:34: May my speech be pleasing to Him; and I indeed will delight in the Lord.
verses.103:35: May sinners cease from the earth, and the unjust, so that they are no more. Bless the Lord, my soul.
verses.104:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, and call on His name; proclaim His works among the nations.
verses.104:2: Sing to Him, and sing psalms to Him; recount all His marvels.
verses.104:3: Glory in His holy name; let the heart of those seeking the Lord rejoice.
verses.104:4: Seek the Lord, and be strengthened; seek His face always.
verses.104:5: Remember His marvels that He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.104:6: offspring of Abraham His servant, sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.104:7: He Himself is the Lord our God; His judgments are throughout the whole earth.
verses.104:8: He has been mindful of His covenant forever, of the word that He commanded for a thousand generations,
verses.104:9: which He made with Abraham, and of His oath to Isaac,
verses.104:10: and He established it for Jacob as a decree, and for Israel as an eternal covenant,
verses.104:11: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, the measuring line of your inheritance,"
verses.104:12: when they were small in number, very few, and sojourners in it.
verses.104:13: And they traveled from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to a different people.
verses.104:14: He allowed no man to harm them, and He rebuked kings on their behalf.
verses.104:15: "Do not touch My anointed ones, and do not act maliciously against My prophets."
verses.104:16: And He called a famine on the land, and shattered every support of bread.
verses.104:17: He sent a man ahead of them: Joseph was sold as a slave.
verses.104:18: They humbled his feet in shackles; iron passed through his soul,
verses.104:19: until his word came. The utterance of the Lord inflamed him.
verses.104:20: The king sent and unbound him; the ruler of peoples, and let him go.
verses.104:21: He appointed him lord of his house and ruler of all his property,
verses.104:22: so that he might instruct his princes like himself, and teach his elders prudence.
verses.104:23: And Israel entered Egypt, and Jacob was a sojourner in the land of Ham.
verses.104:24: And He greatly increased His people, and strengthened them above their enemies.
verses.104:25: He turned their heart to hate His people, and to practice deceit against His servants.
verses.104:26: He sent Moses His servant; Aaron, the very one whom He chose.
verses.104:27: He placed in them the words of His signs and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.104:28: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and He did not embitter His words.
verses.104:29: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
verses.104:30: Their land brought forth frogs in the innermost chambers of their kings.
verses.104:31: He spoke, and dog-flies and gnats came in all their borders.
verses.104:32: He made their rains hail, a consuming fire in their land.
verses.104:33: And He struck their vines and their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their borders.
verses.104:34: He spoke, and the locust came, and the wingless locust without number,
verses.104:35: and it devoured all the grass in their land, and devoured all the fruit of their land.
verses.104:36: And He struck every firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their labor.
verses.104:37: And He brought them out with silver and gold, and there was no one weak in their tribes.
verses.104:38: Egypt rejoiced at their departure, because the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.104:39: He spread out a cloud for their protection, and fire to shine for them through the night.
verses.104:40: They asked, and quail came, and He satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.104:41: He split open the rock, and waters flowed; rivers ran in dry ground.
verses.104:42: For He was mindful of His holy word, which He had with Abraham His servant.
verses.104:43: And He brought out His people with exultation, and His chosen ones with gladness.
verses.104:44: And He gave them the regions of the nations, and they took possession of the labors of the peoples,
verses.104:45: so that they may keep His statutes and seek out His law.
verses.105:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, because He is good, because His mercy lasts forever.
verses.105:2: Who will speak of the mighty acts of the Lord; who will make all His praises heard?
verses.105:3: Blessed are those who guard justice and do righteousness at all times.
verses.105:4: Remember us, Lord, in the favor toward Your people; visit us with Your salvation,
verses.105:5: to look upon the goodness of Your chosen ones, to rejoice in the joy of Your nation, so that You may be praised with Your inheritance.
verses.105:6: We have sinned with our fathers; we have acted unjustly; we have committed iniquity.
verses.105:7: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your wonders; they were not mindful of the abundance of Your mercy. And they provoked Him as they went up into the sea, the Red Sea;
verses.105:8: and He saved them because of His name, to make His might known.
verses.105:9: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; and He led them in the depths as in a desert.
verses.105:10: And He saved them out of the hand of those who hated them, and He redeemed them out of the hand of the enemy.
verses.105:11: And the water covered those who oppressed them; not one of them remained.
verses.105:12: And they believed His words, and they praised His praise.
verses.105:13: They acted quickly; they forgot His works, and they did not wait for His counsel.
verses.105:14: And they craved a craving in the desert, and they tested God in a waterless place.
verses.105:15: And He gave them their petition, and He sent satiety into their souls.
verses.105:16: And they provoked Moses in the camp, and Aaron, the holy one of the Lord.
verses.105:17: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, and it covered over the congregation of Abiram.
verses.105:18: And a fire blazed up in their assembly; a flame burned up the sinners.
verses.105:19: And they made a calf at Horeb, and they worshiped a carved image.
verses.105:20: And they exchanged their glory for the likeness of a calf eating grass.
verses.105:21: They forgot God, who saved them, who performed great deeds in Egypt,
verses.105:22: wonders in the land of Ham, fearsome deeds at the Red Sea.
verses.105:23: And He said that He would destroy them, had not Moses, His chosen one, stood in the breach in His sight to turn away His wrath, so that He would not destroy them.
verses.105:24: And they regarded the desirable land as nothing; they did not believe His word.
verses.105:25: And they murmured in their tents; they did not heed the voice of the Lord.
verses.105:26: And He raised His hand over them to strike them down in the desert,
verses.105:27: and to cast down their offspring among the nations, and to scatter them in the regions.
verses.105:28: And they were initiated to Baal-peor, and they ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.105:29: And they provoked Him with their contrivances, and ruin was multiplied among them.
verses.105:30: And Phinehas stood up and appeased Him, and the scourge ceased.
verses.105:31: And it was credited to him as righteousness, to generation and generation, forever.
verses.105:32: And they provoked Him at the waters of contradiction, and Moses was distressed because of them,
verses.105:33: because they embittered his spirit, and he made a distinction with his lips.
verses.105:34: They did not destroy the nations about which the Lord spoke to them,
verses.105:35: and they were mingled among the nations, and they learned their works;
verses.105:36: and they served their carved images, and it became a stumbling block to them.
verses.105:37: And they offered their sons and their daughters in sacrifice to demons.
verses.105:38: And they poured out innocent blood, the blood of their sons and their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the carved images of Canaan. And the land was stained with bloodshed,
verses.105:39: and it was defiled by their works, and they committed fornication in their contrivances.
verses.105:40: And the Lord was angry with fury against His people, and He detested His inheritance.
verses.105:41: And He handed them over into the hands of the nations, and those who hated them held dominion over them.
verses.105:42: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled beneath their hands;
verses.105:43: often He delivered them. Yet they themselves embittered Him in their counsel, and they were humbled in their iniquities.
verses.105:44: And He saw when they were oppressed, and He heard their prayer.
verses.105:45: And He was mindful of His covenant, and He relented according to the abundance of His mercy,
verses.105:46: and He granted them mercies in the sight of all who had captured them.
verses.105:47: Save us, Lord our God, and gather us out of the nations, so that we may give thanks to Your holy name and boast in Your praise.
verses.105:48: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, from eternity even to eternity; and all the people will say, "So be it, so be it."
verses.106:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy is forever.
verses.106:2: Let those who were redeemed by the Lord say so, whom He redeemed from the hand of the enemy, and He gathered them from the regions,
verses.106:3: from the rising of the sun and its setting, from the north and the sea.
verses.106:4: They wandered in the wilderness, in a waterless place; they did not find the way to a city of habitation.
verses.106:5: Hungering and thirsting, their soul failed within them.
verses.106:6: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He rescued them from their distresses;
verses.106:7: and He led them onto a straight way, so that they might go into a city of habitation.
verses.106:8: Let His mercies give thanks to the Lord, and His wonders to the sons of men.
verses.106:9: For He has satisfied the empty soul, and the hungry soul He has satisfied with good things.
verses.106:10: Those sitting in darkness and the shadow of death, bound in destitution and iron.
verses.106:11: Because they provoked the utterances of God, and they exasperated the counsel of the Most High.
verses.106:12: And their heart was humbled in labors; they grew weak, and there was no one to help.
verses.106:13: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He freed them from their distresses.
verses.106:14: And He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and He tore apart their bonds.
verses.106:15: Let His mercies give thanks to the Lord, and His wonders to the sons of men.
verses.106:16: For He has crushed bronze gates, and He has broken iron bars.
verses.106:17: He took them up from the way of their iniquity, for because of their injustices they were humbled.
verses.106:18: Their soul loathed all food, and they came near, even to the gates of death.
verses.106:19: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He freed them from their distresses.
verses.106:20: He sent His word and healed them, and He rescued them from their destructions.
verses.106:21: Let His mercies give thanks to the Lord, and His wonders to the sons of men.
verses.106:22: And let them offer a sacrifice of praise, and proclaim His works in exultation.
verses.106:23: Those who go down to the sea in ships, doing work in many waters:
verses.106:24: they themselves saw the works of the Lord, and His wonders in the deep.
verses.106:25: He spoke, and a storm wind arose, and its waves were lifted high.
verses.106:26: They ascend all the way to the heavens, and they descend all the way to the abysses; their soul was melting away in evils.
verses.106:27: They were thrown into turmoil, and they were shaken like a drunkard, and all their wisdom was devoured.
verses.106:28: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He brought them out of their distresses.
verses.106:29: And He stilled its storm into a breeze, and its waves fell silent.
verses.106:30: And they rejoiced because they fell silent, and He led them into the harbor of their desire.
verses.106:31: Let His mercies give thanks to the Lord, and His wonders to the sons of men.
verses.106:32: And let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people, and let them praise Him in the seat of the elders.
verses.106:33: He turned rivers into a desert, and outlets of water into thirst;
verses.106:34: a fruitful land into saltiness, because of the wickedness of those dwelling in it.
verses.106:35: He turned a desert into pools of water, and a land without water into outlets of water.
verses.106:36: And He settled the hungry there, and they established a city of habitation:
verses.106:37: and they sowed fields and planted vineyards, and they produced fruit of birth.
verses.106:38: And He blessed them, and they were greatly multiplied, and He did not diminish their livestock.
verses.106:39: And they became few and were harassed by the tribulation of evils and sorrow.
verses.106:40: Contempt was poured out upon princes, and He made them wander in a trackless place, and not on a way.
verses.106:41: And He helped the poor man out of poverty, and He made families like sheep.
verses.106:42: The upright will see and rejoice, and all iniquity will close its mouth.
verses.106:43: Who is wise, and will observe these things, and understand the mercies of the Lord?
verses.107:1: A song of a psalm, for David himself.
verses.107:2: My heart is ready, God, my heart is ready; I will sing and make melody in my glory.
verses.107:3: Arise, my glory; arise, psaltery and lyre; I will arise at dawn.
verses.107:4: I will give thanks to You among the peoples, Lord, and I will make melody to You among the nations,
verses.107:5: for great above the heavens is Your mercy, and up to the clouds is Your truth.
verses.107:6: Be exalted above the heavens, God, and let Your glory be above all the earth,
verses.107:7: so that Your beloved ones may be freed. Save by Your right hand, and hear me.
verses.107:8: God has spoken in His sanctuary: "I will exult, and I will divide Shechem, and I will measure out the valley of tents.
verses.107:9: Mine is Gilead, and Mine is Manasseh, and Ephraim is the support of My head. Judah is My king;
verses.107:10: Moab is the basin of My hope; over Edom I will stretch out My sandal; to Me foreigners have been made friends."
verses.107:11: Who will lead me into a fortified city? Who will lead me all the way into Edom?
verses.107:12: Is it not You, God, who rejected us? And will You not go out, God, with our armies?
verses.107:13: Give us help from tribulation, for the salvation of man is vain.
verses.107:14: In God we will act with valor, and He Himself will reduce our enemies to nothing.
verses.108:1: To the end. A psalm of David.
verses.108:2: God, do not keep silent about my praise, because the mouth of a sinner and the mouth of a deceitful man have been opened against me.
verses.108:3: They spoke against me with a deceitful tongue, and they surrounded me with words of hatred, and attacked me without cause.
verses.108:4: Instead of loving me, they slandered me; but I kept praying.
verses.108:5: And they set evil against me for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.108:6: Appoint a sinner over him, and let the devil stand at his right hand.
verses.108:7: When he is judged, let him come out condemned, and let his prayer become sin.
verses.108:8: Let his days be few, and let another receive his office of oversight.
verses.108:9: Let his children become orphans, and his wife a widow.
verses.108:10: Tottering, let his children be moved from place to place and beg, and let them be driven out from their dwellings.
verses.108:11: Let the moneylender search through all his property, and let strangers pillage his labors.
verses.108:12: Let there be no helper for him, nor anyone who has mercy on his fatherless children.
verses.108:13: Let his offspring come to destruction; in one generation let his name be erased.
verses.108:14: Let the iniquity of his fathers return to memory in the sight of the Lord, and let the sin of his mother not be erased.
verses.108:15: Let them be before the Lord always, and let the memory of them perish from the earth,
verses.108:16: because he did not remember to show mercy.
verses.108:18: And he loved cursing, and it will come to him; and he did not want blessing, and it will be kept far from him. And he put on cursing like a garment, and it entered like water into his inward parts and like oil into his bones.
verses.108:19: Let it be to him like a garment with which he is covered, and like a belt with which he is always bound.
verses.108:20: This is the work of those who slander me before the Lord, and who speak evil against my soul.
verses.108:21: And You, Lord, Lord, deal with me for the sake of Your name, because Your mercy is sweet.
verses.108:22: Deliver me, because I am needy and poor, and my heart is deeply troubled within me.
verses.108:23: Like a shadow when it declines, I have been carried away, and I have been shaken off like locusts.
verses.108:24: My knees have been weakened from fasting, and my flesh has been changed because of oil.
verses.108:25: And I have become a reproach to them; they saw me and shook their heads.
verses.108:26: Help me, Lord my God; save me according to Your mercy.
verses.108:27: And let them know that this is Your hand, and You, Lord, have done it.
verses.108:28: They will curse, and You will bless; let those who rise up against me be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
verses.108:29: Let those who slander me be clothed with shame, and let them be covered with their disgrace like a double cloak.
verses.108:30: I will give thanks to the Lord exceedingly with my mouth, and I will praise Him in the midst of many,
verses.108:31: because He has stood at the right hand of the poor man, so that He might save my soul from persecutors.
verses.109:1: A psalm of David. The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand until I set Your enemies as a footstool for Your feet."
verses.109:2: The Lord will send out the rod of Your power from Zion; rule in the midst of Your enemies.
verses.109:3: With You is sovereignty in the day of Your power, in the splendors of the holy ones; from the womb, before the morning star, I have begotten You.
verses.109:4: The Lord has sworn, and He will not relent: "You are a priest for eternity according to the order of Melchizedek."
verses.109:5: The Lord is at Your right hand; He has shattered kings in the day of His wrath.
verses.109:6: He will judge among the nations; He will fill up ruins; He will crush heads in the land of many.
verses.109:7: From the stream along the way He will drink; therefore He will lift His head high.
verses.110:1: Hallelujah. I will give thanks to You, Lord, with my whole heart, in the council of the righteous and the congregation.
verses.110:2: Great are the works of the Lord, sought out for all His purposes.
verses.110:3: Praise and magnificence are His work, and His righteousness remains forever and ever.
verses.110:4: He made a memorial of His wonders; the Lord is merciful and compassionate.
verses.110:5: He gave food to those who fear Him; He will be mindful of His covenant forever.
verses.110:6: He will declare the power of His works to His people,
verses.110:7: so that He may give them the inheritance of the nations. The works of His hands are truth and judgment.
verses.110:8: Faithful are all His commandments, established forever and ever, done in truth and equity.
verses.110:9: He sent redemption to His people; He commanded His covenant for eternity. Holy and awe-inspiring is His name.
verses.110:10: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the Lord; good understanding belongs to all who practice it; His praise remains forever and ever.
verses.111:1: Hallelujah, of the return of Haggai and Zechariah. Blessed is the man who fears the Lord; he will greatly delight in His commands.
verses.111:2: Mighty on the earth will be his offspring; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.111:3: Glory and wealth are in his house, and his righteousness remains forever and ever.
verses.111:4: Light has dawned in darkness for the upright: merciful, and compassionate, and righteous.
verses.111:5: Pleasant is the man who shows mercy and lends; he will arrange his words in judgment,
verses.111:6: because he will never be shaken.
verses.111:7: The righteous man will be in eternal remembrance; he will not fear a bad report. His heart is ready to hope in the Lord,
verses.111:8: his heart is established; he will not be shaken until he looks down on his enemies.
verses.111:9: He distributed, he gave to the poor; his righteousness remains forever and ever; his horn will be lifted high in glory.
verses.111:10: The sinner will see and become angry; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desire of sinners will perish.
verses.112:1: Hallelujah. Praise the Lord, servants; praise the name of the Lord.
verses.112:2: May the name of the Lord be blessed from this time on and forever.
verses.112:3: From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the Lord is praiseworthy.
verses.112:4: High above all nations is the Lord, and above the heavens is His glory.
verses.112:5: Who is like the Lord our God, who dwells in the heights,
verses.112:6: and looks upon lowly things in heaven and on earth?
verses.112:7: Raising the needy man from the earth, and lifting the poor man from the dung,
verses.112:8: so that He may seat him with princes, with the princes of His people.
verses.112:9: He who makes the barren woman dwell in a house, a rejoicing mother of children.
verses.113:1: Hallelujah. At the departure of Israel from Egypt, of the house of Jacob from a foreign people,
verses.113:2: Judea became His sanctuary; Israel, His dominion.
verses.113:3: The sea saw and fled; the Jordan was turned backward.
verses.113:4: The mountains leaped like rams, and the hills like lambs of the sheep.
verses.113:5: What is the matter with you, sea, that you fled? And you, Jordan, that you were turned backward?
verses.113:6: Mountains, did you leap like rams? And hills, like lambs of the sheep?
verses.113:7: Before the face of the Lord the earth was shaken, before the face of the God of Jacob,
verses.113:8: who turned the rock into pools of water, and the cliff into springs of water.
verses.113:9: Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to Your name give glory,
verses.113:10: because of Your mercy and Your truth, so that the nations may never say, "Where is their God?"
verses.113:11: But our God is in heaven; all that He willed, He has done.
verses.113:12: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the works of human hands.
verses.113:13: They have a mouth, and they will not speak; they have eyes, and they will not see.
verses.113:14: They have ears, and they will not hear; they have nostrils, and they will not smell.
verses.113:15: They have hands, and they will not feel; they have feet, and they will not walk; they will not cry out with their throat.
verses.113:16: May those who make them become like them, and all who trust in them.
verses.113:17: The house of Israel hoped in the Lord; He is their helper and their protector.
verses.113:18: The house of Aaron hoped in the Lord; He is their helper and their protector.
verses.113:19: Those who fear the Lord hoped in the Lord; He is their helper and their protector.
verses.113:20: The Lord was mindful of us and blessed us. He blessed the house of Israel; He blessed the house of Aaron.
verses.113:21: He blessed all who fear the Lord, the small along with the great.
verses.113:22: May the Lord add to you, to you and to your children.
verses.113:23: Blessed are you by the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.113:24: The heaven of heaven belongs to the Lord, but the earth He gave to the children of men.
verses.113:25: The dead will not praise You, Lord, nor all who descend into the underworld;
verses.113:26: but we who live bless the Lord from this time on and forever.
verses.114:1: Hallelujah. I have loved, because the Lord will listen to the voice of my prayer.
verses.114:2: For He has inclined His ear to me, and in my days I will call out.
verses.114:3: The pains of death surrounded me, and the perils of the underworld found me. I found distress and pain,
verses.114:4: and I called upon the name of the Lord: "Lord, set my soul free."
verses.114:5: Merciful and righteous is the Lord, and our God shows mercy.
verses.114:6: The Lord watches over the little ones; I was brought low, and He set me free.
verses.114:7: Return, my soul, to your rest, for the Lord has done good to you,
verses.114:8: because He has rescued my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from slipping.
verses.114:9: I will be pleasing to the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.115:1: Hallelujah. I believed, for which reason I spoke; but I was brought exceedingly low.
verses.115:2: I said in my bewilderment, "Every man is a liar."
verses.115:3: What should I render to the Lord for all that He has rendered to me?
verses.115:4: I will receive the cup of salvation, and I will call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.115:6: The death of His holy ones is precious in the sight of the Lord.
verses.115:7: Lord, for I am Your servant; I am Your servant, and the son of Your maidservant. You have broken my bonds;
verses.115:8: to You I will offer a sacrifice of praise, and I will call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.115:9: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the sight of all His people,
verses.115:10: in the courts of the house of the Lord, in the midst of you, Jerusalem.
verses.116:1: Hallelujah. Praise the Lord, all nations; praise Him, all peoples.
verses.116:2: For His mercy has been established over us, and the truth of the Lord remains forever.
verses.117:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, because He is good, because His mercy is forever.
verses.117:2: Let Israel say now that He is good, that His mercy is forever.
verses.117:3: Let the house of Aaron say now that His mercy is forever.
verses.117:4: Let those who fear the Lord say now that His mercy is forever.
verses.117:5: Out of distress I called on the Lord, and the Lord heard me in a broad space.
verses.117:6: The Lord is my helper; I will not fear what man may do to me.
verses.117:7: The Lord is my helper, and I will look down on my enemies.
verses.117:8: It is good to trust in the Lord rather than to trust in man.
verses.117:9: It is good to hope in the Lord rather than to hope in princes.
verses.117:10: All the nations encircled me, and in the name of the Lord, indeed I took vengeance on them.
verses.117:11: Surrounding me, they surrounded me, and in the name of the Lord, indeed I took vengeance on them.
verses.117:12: They surrounded me like bees, and they blazed up like fire among thorns; and in the name of the Lord, indeed I took vengeance on them.
verses.117:13: Having been pushed, I was overturned so that I would fall, and the Lord upheld me.
verses.117:14: My strength and my praise is the Lord, and He has become salvation for me.
verses.117:15: The sound of exultation and salvation is in the tents of the righteous.
verses.117:16: The right hand of the Lord has acted with power; the right hand of the Lord has exalted me; the right hand of the Lord has acted with power.
verses.117:17: I will not die, but I will live, and I will recount the works of the Lord.
verses.117:18: Chastising me, the Lord has chastised me, and He has not handed me over to death.
verses.117:19: Open for me the gates of righteousness; having entered into them, I will give thanks to the Lord.
verses.117:20: This is the gate of the Lord; the righteous will enter into it.
verses.117:21: I will give thanks to You, because You have heard me and have become salvation for me.
verses.117:22: The stone that the builders rejected, this one has become the head of the corner.
verses.117:23: By the Lord this has been done, and it is wonderful in our eyes.
verses.117:24: This is the day that the Lord has made; let us exult and be glad in it.
verses.117:25: Lord, save me; Lord, grant good prosperity.
verses.117:26: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord; we have blessed you from the house of the Lord.
verses.117:27: The Lord is God, and He has shone on us. Establish a solemn day with dense boughs, up to the horn of the altar.
verses.117:28: You are my God, and I will give thanks to You; You are my God, and I will exalt You. I will give thanks to You, because You have heard me and have become salvation for me.
verses.117:29: Give thanks to the Lord, because He is good, because His mercy is forever.
verses.118:1: Hallelujah. Aleph: Blessed are the unblemished in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.
verses.118:2: Blessed are those who examine His testimonies; with their whole heart they seek Him.
verses.118:3: For those who practice iniquity have not walked in His ways.
verses.118:4: You have commanded that Your commandments be kept to the utmost.
verses.118:5: Oh, may my ways be directed to keep Your ordinances.
verses.118:6: Then I will not be put to shame, when I look closely into all Your commandments.
verses.118:7: I will give thanks to You in uprightness of heart, in that I have learned the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:8: I will keep Your ordinances; do not abandon me completely.
verses.118:9: Beth: By what does a younger man correct his way? By keeping Your words.
verses.118:10: With my whole heart I have sought You; do not drive me away from Your commandments.
verses.118:11: In my heart I have hidden Your utterances, so that I may not sin against You.
verses.118:12: Blessed are You, Lord; teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:13: With my lips I have declared all the judgments of Your mouth.
verses.118:14: In the way of Your testimonies I have delighted, just as in all riches.
verses.118:15: I will occupy myself with Your commandments, and I will consider Your ways.
verses.118:16: I will meditate on Your ordinances; I will not forget Your words.
verses.118:17: Gimel: Reward Your servant, give me life, and I will keep Your words.
verses.118:18: Uncover my eyes, and I will consider the wonders from Your law.
verses.118:19: I am a foreign resident on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
verses.118:20: My soul has longed to desire Your ordinances at all times.
verses.118:21: You have rebuked the proud; cursed are those who turn aside from Your commandments.
verses.118:22: Take away from me reproach and contempt, because I have sought Your testimonies.
verses.118:23: For indeed princes sat and were speaking against me, but Your servant was occupied with Your ordinances.
verses.118:24: For Your testimonies are indeed my meditation, and Your ordinances are my counsel.
verses.118:25: Daleth: My soul has clung to the pavement; give me life according to Your word.
verses.118:26: I recounted my ways, and You heard me; teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:27: Instruct me in the way of Your ordinances, and I will occupy myself with Your wonders.
verses.118:28: My soul has grown drowsy from weariness; strengthen me in Your words.
verses.118:29: Remove the way of iniquity from me, and by Your law have mercy on me.
verses.118:30: The way of truth I have chosen; I have not forgotten Your judgments.
verses.118:31: I have clung to Your testimonies, Lord; do not put me to shame.
verses.118:32: I ran the way of Your commandments when You enlarged my heart.
verses.118:33: He: Set as a law for me, Lord, the way of Your ordinances, and I will seek it always.
verses.118:34: Give me understanding, and I will examine Your law, and I will keep it with my whole heart.
verses.118:35: Guide me into the path of Your commandments, because I have desired it.
verses.118:36: Incline my heart toward Your testimonies, and not toward greed.
verses.118:37: Turn my eyes away so that they may not see emptiness; in Your way give me life.
verses.118:38: Establish Your utterance for Your servant in the fear of You.
verses.118:39: Cut away my reproach, which I have suspected, because Your judgments are pleasant.
verses.118:40: Look, I have longed for Your commandments; in Your equity give me life.
verses.118:41: Vav: And let Your mercy come upon me, Lord, Your salvation according to Your utterance.
verses.118:42: And I will reply with a word to those who reproach me, because I have hoped in Your words.
verses.118:43: And do not completely take away the word of truth from my mouth, because I have hoped exceedingly in Your judgments.
verses.118:44: And I will keep Your law always, forever and ever.
verses.118:45: And I walked in a broad place, because I have sought Your commandments.
verses.118:46: And I spoke of Your testimonies in the sight of kings, and I was not put to shame.
verses.118:47: And I meditated on Your commandments, which I have loved.
verses.118:48: And I lifted up my hands toward Your commandments, which I have loved, and I was occupied with Your ordinances.
verses.118:49: Zayin: Remember Your word to Your servant, in which You have given me hope.
verses.118:50: This has comforted me in my humiliation, because Your utterance has given me life.
verses.118:51: The proud acted wickedly in every way, yet I have not turned aside from Your law.
verses.118:52: I remembered Your judgments from ages past, Lord, and I was comforted.
verses.118:53: Faintness has seized me because of the sinners who abandon Your law.
verses.118:54: Your ordinances were worthy of song to me in the place of my sojourning.
verses.118:55: I remembered Your name in the night, Lord, and I kept Your law.
verses.118:56: This has happened to me, because I sought Your ordinances.
verses.118:57: Heth: My portion, Lord, I have said that I will keep Your law.
verses.118:58: I have implored Your face with my whole heart; have mercy on me according to Your utterance.
verses.118:59: I reflected on my ways, and I turned my feet toward Your testimonies.
verses.118:60: I am prepared, and I am not troubled, so that I may keep Your commandments.
verses.118:61: The cords of sinners have wrapped around me, and I have not forgotten Your law.
verses.118:62: At midnight I rose to give thanks to You for the judgments of Your justification.
verses.118:63: I am a partner of all who fear You and keep Your commandments.
verses.118:64: The earth is full of Your mercy, Lord; teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:65: Teth: You have shown goodness to Your servant, Lord, according to Your word.
verses.118:66: Teach me goodness, discipline, and knowledge, because I have believed Your commandments.
verses.118:67: Before I was humbled, I erred; therefore I have kept Your utterance.
verses.118:68: You are good, and in Your goodness teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:69: The iniquity of the proud has been multiplied against me, but I will examine Your commandments with my whole heart.
verses.118:70: Their heart has curdled like milk, yet I have meditated on Your law.
verses.118:71: It is good for me that You humbled me, so that I may learn Your ordinances.
verses.118:72: The law of Your mouth is good for me beyond thousands of gold and silver.
verses.118:73: Yod: Your hands made me and molded me; give me understanding, and I will learn Your commandments.
verses.118:74: Those who fear You will see me and rejoice, because I have hoped exceedingly in Your words.
verses.118:75: I have come to know, Lord, that Your judgments are equity, and that in Your truth You have humbled me.
verses.118:76: Let Your mercy come to comfort me, according to Your utterance to Your servant.
verses.118:77: Let Your compassions come to me, and I will live, because Your law is my meditation.
verses.118:78: Let the proud be put to shame, because they have unjustly committed iniquity against me; but I will occupy myself with Your commandments.
verses.118:79: May those who fear You turn back to me, and those who know Your testimonies.
verses.118:80: Let my heart be unblemished in Your ordinances, so that I may not be put to shame.
verses.118:81: Kaph: My soul has grown faint for Your salvation, and I have hoped exceedingly in Your word.
verses.118:82: My eyes have grown faint for Your utterance, saying, "When will You comfort me?"
verses.118:83: For I have become like a wineskin in the frost; I have not forgotten Your ordinances.
verses.118:84: How many are the days of Your servant? When will You render judgment on those who persecute me?
verses.118:85: The wicked have recounted fables to me, but not like Your law.
verses.118:86: All Your commandments are truth: they have wrongfully persecuted me; help me.
verses.118:87: They nearly brought me to an end on the earth, but I have not abandoned Your commandments.
verses.118:88: According to Your mercy give me life, and I will keep the testimonies of Your mouth.
verses.118:89: Lamed: Forever, Lord, Your word remains in heaven.
verses.118:90: Your truth is from generation to generation; You have founded the earth, and it remains.
verses.118:91: By Your ordering the day continues, because all things serve You.
verses.118:92: Were it not that Your law is my meditation, then perhaps I would have perished in my humiliation.
verses.118:93: Never will I forget Your ordinances, because in them You have given me life.
verses.118:94: I am Yours; save me, because I have sought Your ordinances.
verses.118:95: Sinners have waited for me to destroy me; I have understood Your testimonies.
verses.118:96: I have seen the end of all perfection; Your commandment is exceedingly wide.
verses.118:97: Mem: How I have loved Your law, Lord! All day long it is my meditation.
verses.118:98: You have made me wiser than my enemies by Your commandment, because it is mine forever.
verses.118:99: Beyond all those who teach me I have understood, because Your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.118:100: Beyond the elders I have understood, because I have sought Your commandments.
verses.118:101: From every evil way I have held back my feet, so that I may keep Your words.
verses.118:102: From Your judgments I have not turned aside, because You have set a law for me.
verses.118:103: How sweet to my palate are Your utterances! Beyond honey to my mouth.
verses.118:104: From Your commandments I have understood; therefore I have hated every way of iniquity.
verses.118:105: Nun: A lamp for my feet is Your word, and a light for my paths.
verses.118:106: I have sworn and resolved to keep the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:107: I have been humbled completely, Lord; give me life according to Your word.
verses.118:108: Make the freewill offerings of my mouth well-pleasing, Lord, and teach me Your judgments.
verses.118:109: My soul is in my hands always, and I have not forgotten Your law.
verses.118:110: Sinners have set a snare for me, and I have not strayed from Your commandments.
verses.118:111: I have acquired Your testimonies as an inheritance forever, because they are the exultation of my heart.
verses.118:112: I have inclined my heart to perform Your ordinances forever, because of the reward.
verses.118:113: Samekh: I have hated the wicked, and I have loved Your law.
verses.118:114: You are my helper and my upholder, and I have hoped exceedingly in Your word.
verses.118:115: Turn away from me, evildoers, and I will examine the commandments of my God.
verses.118:116: Uphold me according to Your utterance, and I will live, and do not put me to shame in my expectation.
verses.118:117: Help me, and I will be saved, and I will meditate on Your ordinances always.
verses.118:118: You have spurned all who depart from Your judgments, because their thought is unjust.
verses.118:119: I have counted all the sinners of the earth as transgressors; therefore I have loved Your testimonies.
verses.118:120: Pierce through my flesh with the fear of You, for I have feared Your judgments.
verses.118:121: Ayin: I have done judgment and righteousness; do not hand me over to those who slander me.
verses.118:122: Uphold Your servant for good; do not let the proud slander me.
verses.118:123: My eyes have grown faint for Your salvation and for the utterance of Your righteousness.
verses.118:124: Deal with Your servant according to Your mercy, and teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:125: I am Your servant; give me understanding, so that I may know Your testimonies.
verses.118:126: It is time to act, Lord: they have shattered Your law.
verses.118:127: Therefore I have loved Your commandments beyond gold and topaz.
verses.118:128: Therefore I was directed toward all Your commandments; I have hated every wicked way.
verses.118:129: Pe: Your testimonies are wondrous; therefore my soul has examined them.
verses.118:130: The disclosure of Your words sheds light, and it gives understanding to little ones.
verses.118:131: I opened my mouth and drew in breath, because I desired Your commandments.
verses.118:132: Look upon me and have mercy on me, according to the judgment of those who love Your name.
verses.118:133: Direct my steps according to Your utterance, and do not let any unrighteousness rule over me.
verses.118:134: Redeem me from the slanders of people, so that I may keep Your commandments.
verses.118:135: Shine Your face upon Your servant, and teach me Your ordinances.
verses.118:136: My eyes have poured down streams of water, because they have not kept Your law.
verses.118:137: Tsade: You are righteous, Lord, and Your judgment is upright.
verses.118:138: You have commanded Your testimonies as righteousness, and Your truth to the utmost.
verses.118:139: My zeal has made me waste away, because my enemies have forgotten Your words.
verses.118:140: Your utterance is exceedingly refined by fire, and Your servant has loved it.
verses.118:141: I am a mere youth and despised; I have not forgotten Your ordinances.
verses.118:142: Your righteousness is righteousness forever, and Your law is truth.
verses.118:143: Tribulation and anguish have found me; Your commandments are my meditation.
verses.118:144: Your testimonies are equity forever; give me understanding, and I will live.
verses.118:145: Qoph: I have cried out with my whole heart: hear me, Lord; I will seek Your ordinances.
verses.118:146: I have cried out to You; save me, so that I may keep Your commandments.
verses.118:147: I came beforehand in the early morning and cried out, because I have hoped exceedingly in Your words.
verses.118:148: My eyes went beforehand to You at daybreak, so that I might meditate on Your utterances.
verses.118:149: Hear my voice according to Your mercy, Lord, and according to Your judgment give me life.
verses.118:150: Those who persecute me have drawn near to iniquity, but they have become far removed from Your law.
verses.118:151: You are near, Lord, and all Your ways are truth.
verses.118:152: From the beginning I have come to know concerning Your testimonies that You founded them forever.
verses.118:153: Resh: See my humiliation and rescue me, because I have not forgotten Your law.
verses.118:154: Judge my cause and redeem me; for the sake of Your utterance give me life.
verses.118:155: Far from sinners is salvation, because they have not sought Your ordinances.
verses.118:156: Your mercies are many, Lord; according to Your judgment give me life.
verses.118:157: Many are those who persecute me and afflict me; I have not turned aside from Your testimonies.
verses.118:158: I saw the transgressors and was wasting away, because they did not keep Your utterances.
verses.118:159: See that I have loved Your commandments, Lord; in Your mercy give me life.
verses.118:160: The beginning of Your words is truth; forever are all the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:161: Sin: Princes have persecuted me without cause, and at Your words my heart has stood in awe.
verses.118:162: I will rejoice over Your utterances, like one who finds much spoil.
verses.118:163: Iniquity I have hated and detested, but Your law I have loved.
verses.118:164: Seven times a day I have spoken praise to You for the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:165: There is much peace for those who love Your law, and for them there is no stumbling block.
verses.118:166: I waited for Your salvation, Lord, and I have loved Your commandments.
verses.118:167: My soul has kept Your testimonies and has loved them intensely.
verses.118:168: I have observed Your commandments and Your testimonies, because all my ways are in Your sight.
verses.118:169: Tav: Let my supplication draw near in Your sight, Lord; according to Your utterance give me understanding.
verses.118:170: Let my petition enter into Your sight; according to Your utterance rescue me.
verses.118:171: My lips will pour forth a hymn when You have taught me Your ordinances.
verses.118:172: My tongue will declare Your utterance, because all Your commandments are equity.
verses.118:173: Let Your hand come to save me, because I have chosen Your commandments.
verses.118:174: I have yearned for Your salvation, Lord, and Your law is my meditation.
verses.118:175: My soul will live and praise You, and Your judgments will help me.
verses.118:176: I have strayed like a sheep that was lost; seek Your servant, because I have not forgotten Your commandments.
verses.119:1: A song of steps. To the Lord I cried out when I was in distress, and He heard me.
verses.119:2: Lord, deliver my soul from unjust lips and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.119:3: What should be given to you, or what should be added to you, for a deceitful tongue?
verses.119:4: Sharp arrows of the mighty one, with desolating coals.
verses.119:5: Alas for me, because my sojourn has been prolonged! I have lived with those who live in Kedar.
verses.119:6: For a long time my soul has been a sojourner.
verses.119:7: With those who hate peace I was peaceful; when I spoke to them, they attacked me without cause.
verses.120:1: A song of steps. I lifted my eyes to the mountains, from where help will come to me.
verses.120:2: My help is from the Lord, the One who made heaven and earth.
verses.120:3: May He not give your foot over to unsteadiness, nor may He who guards you slumber.
verses.120:4: Look, He who guards Israel will not slumber or sleep.
verses.120:5: The Lord guards you; the Lord is your protection over your right hand.
verses.120:6: By day the sun will not burn you, nor the moon by night.
verses.120:7: The Lord guards you from all evil; may the Lord guard your soul.
verses.120:8: May the Lord guard your coming in and your going out, from this time on and forever.
verses.121:1: A song of steps. I rejoiced in the things that were spoken to me: "We will go into the house of the Lord."
verses.121:2: Our feet were standing in your courts, Jerusalem.
verses.121:3: Jerusalem, which is built as a city, whose participation is in unity.
verses.121:4: For there the tribes went up, the tribes of the Lord, a testimony for Israel, to give praise to the name of the Lord.
verses.121:5: For there thrones were set in judgment, thrones over the house of David.
verses.121:6: Ask for the things that pertain to the peace of Jerusalem, and abundance for those who love you.
verses.121:7: May there be peace in your strength, and abundance in your towers.
verses.121:8: For the sake of my brothers and my neighbors, I spoke peace concerning you.
verses.121:9: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I sought good things for you.
verses.122:1: A song of steps. To You I have lifted up my eyes, You who dwell in the heavens.
verses.122:2: Look, just as the eyes of servants are on the hands of their masters, just as the eyes of a maidservant are on the hands of her mistress, so our eyes are toward the Lord our God, until He has mercy on us.
verses.122:3: Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us, for we have been exceedingly filled with scorn;
verses.122:4: for our soul has been exceedingly filled: reproach to those living in abundance, and scorn to the proud.
verses.123:1: A song of steps. Had it not been that the Lord was among us, let Israel say now,
verses.123:2: had it not been that the Lord was among us when people rose up against us,
verses.123:3: perhaps they would have swallowed us alive; when their fury raged against us,
verses.123:4: perhaps the water would have engulfed us;
verses.123:5: our soul passed through a torrent; perhaps our soul would have passed through unbearable water.
verses.123:6: Blessed is the Lord, who did not give us as prey to their teeth.
verses.123:7: Our soul has been rescued like a sparrow from the snare of the hunters; the snare has been broken, and we have been set free.
verses.123:8: Our aid is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.124:1: A song of steps. Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion; he will never be shaken who dwells
verses.124:2: in Jerusalem. Mountains are all around it, and the Lord is all around His people, from this time on and forever.
verses.124:3: For the Lord will not leave the rod of sinners over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous may not stretch out their hands toward iniquity,
verses.124:4: do good, Lord, to the good and to the upright in heart.
verses.124:5: But as for those who turn aside into entanglements, the Lord will lead them with those who work iniquity. Peace upon Israel!
verses.125:1: A song of the steps. When the Lord turned back the captivity of Zion, we became like those who have been comforted.
verses.125:2: Then our mouth was filled with joy, and our tongue with exultation. Then they will say among the nations, "The Lord has done great things with them."
verses.125:3: The Lord has done great things with us; we have become glad.
verses.125:4: Turn back our captivity, Lord, like a torrent in the south.
verses.125:5: Those who sow in tears will reap in exultation.
verses.125:6: As they went, they were going and weeping, scattering their seeds. Yet as they come, they will come with exultation, bearing their sheaves.
verses.126:1: A song of the steps, of Solomon. Unless the Lord builds the house, those who build it have labored in vain. Unless the Lord guards the city, the one who guards it stays awake to no avail.
verses.126:2: It is in vain for you to rise before daylight; rise after you have sat down, you who eat the bread of pain. When He gives sleep to His beloved,
verses.126:3: look, the inheritance of the Lord is sons; the reward is the fruit of the womb.
verses.126:4: Like arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the sons of those who have been shaken out.
verses.126:5: Blessed is the man who has filled his desire from them; he will not be put to shame when he speaks to his enemies in the gate.
verses.127:1: A song of the steps. Blessed are all who fear the Lord, who walk in His ways.
verses.127:2: Because you will eat the labors of your hands, you are blessed, and it will go well for you.
verses.127:3: Your wife will be like an abundant vine in the sides of your house; your sons will be like new shoots of olive trees all around your table.
verses.127:4: Look, in this way the man who fears the Lord will be blessed.
verses.127:5: May the Lord bless you from Zion, and may you see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.127:6: And may you see the sons of your sons: peace upon Israel.
verses.128:1: A song of steps. "Often they have assailed me from my youth," let Israel now say;
verses.128:2: "often they have assailed me from my youth, and indeed they could not overpower me."
verses.128:3: Upon my back sinners have built; they have prolonged their iniquity.
verses.128:4: The righteous Lord has severed the necks of sinners.
verses.128:5: Let them be put to shame and turned backward, all who hate Zion.
verses.128:6: Let them become like the grass of the rooftops, which has dried up before it is pulled up,
verses.128:7: with which the one who reaps has not filled his hand, nor the one who gathers sheaves his bosom.
verses.128:8: And those who were passing by did not say, "The Lord's blessing be upon you. We have blessed you in the name of the Lord."
verses.129:1: A song of steps. From the depths I have cried out to You, Lord;
verses.129:2: Lord, hear my voice. Let Your ears become attentive to the voice of my plea.
verses.129:3: If You should take note of iniquities, Lord, Lord, who will endure?
verses.129:5: For with You there is propitiation, and because of Your law I have waited for You, Lord. My soul has waited upon His word;
verses.129:6: my soul has hoped in the Lord.
verses.129:7: For with the Lord there is mercy, and abundant redemption is with Him.
verses.129:8: And He Himself will redeem Israel from all its iniquities.
verses.130:1: A song of steps, of David. Lord, my heart has not been exalted, nor have my eyes been lifted up; nor have I walked in great things, nor in marvelous things above me.
verses.130:2: If I did not think humbly, but have exalted my soul: just as a weaned child is upon his mother, so is retribution in my soul.
